11	/-!
12	# Cover independence for section-cut evaluation divisors
13	
14	The evaluation divisor used by the arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`
15	producer is cut from an actual glued section.  Pulling such a divisor through an affine
16	coefficient change retains the pulled-back pointed cover, whereas the direct construction
17	uses the canonical pointed cover of the base-changed cocycle datum.  This file supplies the
18	pure refinement step between those covers: local equations cut by the same section on any
19	two subordinated pointed covers are `DivEq`.
20	
21	The comparison unit is the datum's transition unit restricted to the common refinement.
22	Thus this result records construction-level divisor equality, not merely equality of Picard
23	classes, and assumes neither `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` nor a pullback square.
24	-/
25	
26	set_option autoImplicit false
27	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
29	
30	universe u
31	
32	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
33	
34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
35	
36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
37	
38	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
39	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
40	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k}
41	
42	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
43	
44	/-- Local equations cut by one glued section are independent, up to `DivEq`, of the
45	subordinated pointed cover used to write them.  The witness is the intersection cover and
46	the restricted transition unit between the two selected datum pieces. -/
47	theorem sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section
48	    [IsAffineHom pi]
49	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
50	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
51	    (W W' : (relCurve C B).PointedCover)
52	    (σ σ' : relCurve C B → D.index)
53	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, W.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x))
54	    (hσ' : ∀ x : relCurve C B, W'.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ' x))
55	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (x : relCurve C B) (hx : x ∈ D.pieces j),
56	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) x hx).hom (D.component s j)
57	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk x)) :
58	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
59	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s W σ hσ hreg)
60	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s W' σ' hσ' hreg) := by
61	  refine ⟨W ⊓ W', (fun _ => inf_le_left), (fun _ => inf_le_right), fun x => ?_⟩
62	  have hleft : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x) :=
63	    inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)
64	  have hright : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
65	    inf_le_right.trans (hσ' x)
66	  have hoverlap : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
67	    le_inf hleft hright
68	  have htriple : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
69	    le_inf (le_inf le_top hleft) hright
70	  refine ⟨(relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)), ?_⟩
71	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom htriple)
72	    (s.property (σ x) (σ' x))
73	  rw [map_mul] at key
74	  simp only [sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
75	  change (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left
76	      ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component s (σ x))) =
77	    ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)) :
78	      Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)) *
79	      (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right
80	        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ' x) (D.component s (σ' x)))
81	  rw [show (((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)) :
82	      Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)ˣ) : Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)) =
83	        (relCurve C B).resHom hoverlap
84	          (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x)))
85	      from rfl, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component]
86	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key ⊢
87	  exact key
88	
89	/-! ## Coefficient-change naturality -/
90	
91	/-- Restricting the datum-piece comparison to the actual preimage piece gives the
92	arbitrary-affine section comparison.  This is the pointwise equation bridge between the
93	base-changed glued section and `LocalEquations.pullbackEqn`. -/
94	theorem resHom_piecesMap_eq_relAffSectionsMap
95	    [IsAffineHom pi]
96	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
97	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
98	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (j : D.index)
99	    (t : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)) :
100	    (relCurve C B').resHom
101	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' j).ge
102	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j t) =
103	      relAffSectionsMap C B' (D.pieces j) t := by
104	  cases j with
105	  | inl j =>
106	      simpa only [BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap, pieceSectionsMap,
107	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange, Sum.elim_inl,
108	        relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom_refl] using
109	        ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
110	          (le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
111	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inl j))
112	          (le_rfl : relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤
113	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
114	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' (Sum.inl j)).ge t)
115	  | inr j =>
116	      simpa only [BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap, pieceSectionsMap,
117	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange, Sum.elim_inr,
118	        relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom_refl] using
119	        ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
120	          (le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
121	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inr j))
122	          (le_rfl : relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤
123	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
124	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' (Sum.inr j)).ge t)
125	
126	/-- The equation obtained by pulling back the canonical section-cut local equations is the
127	arbitrary-affine comparison of the selected datum component. -/
128	theorem pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquations_eq_relAffSectionsMap
129	    [IsFinite pi] [IsNoetherianRing B]
130	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
131	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
132	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
133	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
134	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
135	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (z : relCurve C B') :
136	    Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C B B')
137	        (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib) z =
138	      relAffSectionsMap C B'
139	        (D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base z)))
140	        (D.component s (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base z))) := by
141	  simp [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn,
142	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
143	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations,
144	    relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom]
145	
146	/-- Pulling back the divisor cut by a fibrewise-regular glued section is `DivEq` to the
147	divisor cut by the compared section on the canonical cover after an arbitrary affine
148	coefficient change.  The first comparison has unit `1` on the pulled cover; the second is
149	the transition-unit refinement supplied by `sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section`. -/
150	theorem pullback_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_divEq_sectionsMapTop
151	    [IsFinite pi] [IsNoetherianRing B]
152	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
153	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
154	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
155	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
156	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
157	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] [IsNoetherianRing B']
158	    (hfib' : ∀ (j : (D.baseChange B').index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B'),
159	      Function.Injective
160	        ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B'
161	          ((D.baseChange B').component (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j)).rTensor
162	            p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
163	    (hpull : ∀ (y z : relCurve C B')
164	      (hz : z ∈ ((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).cover.pullback
165	        (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y),
166	      ((relCurve C B').presheaf.germ
167	        (((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).cover.pullback
168	          (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y) z hz).hom
169	          (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C B B')
170	            (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib) y) ∈
171	        nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B').presheaf.stalk z)) :
172	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
173	      ((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).pullback
174	        (relCurveMap C B B') hpull)
175	      ((D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
176	        (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) hfib') := by
177	  let f := relCurveMap C B B'
178	  let W := D.pointedCover.pullback f
179	  let sigma : relCurve C B' → D.index := fun z => D.pieceIndex (f.base z)
180	  let hsigma : ∀ z : relCurve C B', W.opens z ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces (sigma z) :=
181	    fun z => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' z
182	  let s' := D.sectionsMapTop B' s
183	  let hreg' : ∀ (j : (D.baseChange B').index) (z : relCurve C B')
184	      (hz : z ∈ (D.baseChange B').pieces j),
185	      ((relCurve C B').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) z hz).hom
186	          ((D.baseChange B').component s' j) ∈
187	        nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B').presheaf.stalk z) :=
188	    fun j z hz =>
189	      (D.baseChange B').germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors s' j (hfib' j) z hz
190	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq.trans (d₂ :=
191	    (D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquations s' W sigma hsigma hreg') ?_ ?_
192	  · refine ⟨W, (fun _ => le_rfl), (fun _ => le_rfl), fun z => ?_⟩
193	    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
194	    rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
195	    simp only [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullback_eqn, sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
196	    rw [D.pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquations_eq_relAffSectionsMap s hfib B' z]
197	    rw [D.component_sectionsMapTop B' s (sigma z)]
198	    apply congrArg ((relCurve C B').resHom _)
199	    exact (D.resHom_piecesMap_eq_relAffSectionsMap B' (sigma z)
200	      (D.component s (sigma z))).symm
201	  · simpa only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
202	      s', hreg'] using
203	      (D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section s'
204	        W (D.baseChange B').pointedCover sigma (D.baseChange B').pieceIndex
205	        hsigma (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg'
206	
207	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
208	
209	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafPair
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RigidEngine4Relative
8	
9	/-!
10	# The pinned cocycle datum on the relative curve (DAT-1, stage 1d-i, the datum)
11	
12	The **cocycle datum over a `k`-algebra `B`** of the Wave-4 datum worksheet §3.2
13	(BINDING; `informal/spec-dat-1.md` §0), on the pinned relative cover
14	`relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)` of the relative curve `C_B`:
15	
16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCoverData` — the two finite index types `J₀, J₁`, the
17	  basic-open generators `h_j ∈ Γ(Vᵢᴮ, 𝒪)` and the partition witnesses
18	  `∑ j, a_j · h_j = 1` per pinned chart; `pieces` sends `J₀ ⊕ J₁` to the basic opens
19	  `D(h_j)`.
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum` — the cover data together with the
21	  transition units on the pairwise basic-open overlaps (`Units` bundle the inverse
22	  witnesses) and the cocycle law `Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`.
23	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` — the glued sheaf of `B`-modules of the datum
24	  (`gluedSheaf`), with the quasi-coherence packagings on **both pinned charts** and on
25	  the **overlap** as instances (`instQcohOn₀/₁/Inf`, from `gluedQcohOn`: side-`i`'s own
26	  family on chart `i`; side-0's family restricted along `V₀ᴮ ⊓ V₁ᴮ ≤ V₀ᴮ` on the
27	  overlap, through the subordinate-pieces interface).
28	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.pairData` — the two-cover pair data at the pinned relative
29	  coordinates `t₀ᴮ, t₁ᴮ` (`relFiberCoord₀/₁`), through `gluedPairData` (the
30	  componentwise-action hypotheses are `rfl` for the keyed instances).
31	
32	The engine keystones fired on `pairData.pair` are in
33	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafEngine`.
34	-/
35	
36	set_option autoImplicit false
37	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
38	
39	universe u
40	
41	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
42	
43	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
44	
45	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
46	
47	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
48	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
49	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)
50	
51	/-- **The basic-open cover data over `B`** (worksheet §3.2, first half): finite index
52	types `J₀, J₁`, for `j ∈ Jᵢ` a section `h_j` of the pinned chart `Vᵢᴮ` with partition
53	witnesses `∑ j, a_j · h_j = 1` in `Γ(Vᵢᴮ, 𝒪)` — so the basic opens `D(h_j)` cover the
54	chart (`le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one`). -/
55	structure BasicOpenCoverData [IsAffineHom π] : Type (u + 1) where
56	  /-- The chart-0 index. -/
57	  J₀ : Type u
58	  /-- The chart-1 index. -/
59	  J₁ : Type u
60	  /-- The chart-0 index is finite. -/
61	  fintype₀ : Fintype J₀
62	  /-- The chart-1 index is finite. -/
63	  fintype₁ : Fintype J₁
64	  /-- The chart-0 basic-open generators. -/
65	  h₀ : J₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
66	  /-- The chart-1 basic-open generators. -/
67	  h₁ : J₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
68	  /-- The chart-0 partition coefficients. -/
69	  a₀ : J₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
70	  /-- The chart-1 partition coefficients. -/
71	  a₁ : J₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
72	  /-- The chart-0 partition witness. -/
73	  partition₀ : ∑ j : J₀, a₀ j * h₀ j = 1
74	  /-- The chart-1 partition witness. -/
75	  partition₁ : ∑ j : J₁, a₁ j * h₁ j = 1
76	
77	attribute [instance] BasicOpenCoverData.fintype₀ BasicOpenCoverData.fintype₁
78	
79	namespace BasicOpenCoverData
80	
81	variable {C B π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B π)
82	
83	/-- The gluing index of the datum, `J = J₀ ⊕ J₁`. -/
84	abbrev index : Type u := D.J₀ ⊕ D.J₁
85	
86	/-- The pieces of the datum: the basic opens `D(h_j)` of the two pinned charts. -/
87	noncomputable def pieces : D.index → (relCurve C B).Opens :=
88	  Sum.elim (fun j => (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j))
89	    (fun j => (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j))
90	
91	@[simp]
92	lemma pieces_inl (j : D.J₀) :
93	    D.pieces (Sum.inl j) = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) := rfl
94	
95	@[simp]
96	lemma pieces_inr (j : D.J₁) :
97	    D.pieces (Sum.inr j) = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) := rfl
98	
99	/-- The chart-0 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₀ᴮ`. -/
100	lemma cover₀ : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ≤
101	    ⨆ j : D.J₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) :=
102	  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₀ D.h₀ D.partition₀
103	
104	/-- The chart-1 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₁ᴮ`. -/
105	lemma cover₁ : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤
106	    ⨆ j : D.J₁, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) :=
107	  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₁ D.h₁ D.partition₁
108	
109	/-- The chart-0 generators, restricted to the overlap of the pinned charts. -/
110	noncomputable def hInf (j : D.J₀) :
111	    Γ(relCurve C B,
112	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
113	  (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left (D.h₀ j)
114	
115	/-- The restricted chart-0 pieces are subordinate to the pieces of the datum. -/
116	lemma basicOpen_hInf_le (j : D.J₀) :
117	    (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.hInf j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inl j) := by
118	  rw [hInf, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom, pieces_inl]
119	  exact inf_le_right
120	
121	/-- The restricted chart-0 pieces cover the overlap of the pinned charts (the
122	partition witness restricts to a partition witness). -/
123	lemma coverInf : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
124	    ≤ ⨆ j : D.J₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.hInf j) := by
125	  refine le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one
126	    (fun j => (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left (D.a₀ j)) D.hInf ?_
127	  have hres := congrArg
128	    ((relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
129	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀))
130	    D.partition₀
131	  rw [map_sum, map_one] at hres
132	  rw [← hres]
133	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
134	
135	end BasicOpenCoverData
136	
137	/-- **The pinned cocycle datum over `B`** (worksheet §3.2, VERBATIM): the basic-open
138	cover data of the two pinned charts together with transition units on the pairwise
139	basic-open overlaps (with explicit inverse witnesses — `Units`) satisfying the cocycle
140	identities in the overlap section rings (`Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`, including the
141	normalization `g j j = 1`). This is the DAT-1 constructor input and the object RE-5
142	descends. -/
143	structure BasicOpenCocycleDatum [IsAffineHom π] : Type (u + 1) extends
144	    BasicOpenCoverData C B π where
145	  /-- The transition units on the pairwise piece overlaps. -/
146	  unit : ∀ i j : toBasicOpenCoverData.index,
147	    Γ(relCurve C B, toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces i ⊓ toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces j)ˣ
148	  /-- The cocycle law. -/
149	  isGluingCocycle : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces unit
150	
151	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
152	
153	variable {C B π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
154	
155	/-- **The glued sheaf of the datum**: the m-chart cocycle-glued sheaf of `B`-modules on
156	the small Zariski site of the relative curve `C_B`. -/
157	@[reducible] noncomputable def sheaf :
158	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
159	      (ModuleCat.{u} B) :=
160	  gluedSheaf B D.pieces D.unit
161	
162	/-- The quasi-coherence packaging of the datum's glued sheaf on the pinned chart
163	`V₀ᴮ`, from the chart-0 family. -/
164	noncomputable instance instQcohOn₀ :
165	    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ :=
166	  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inl) (h := D.h₀)
167	    (fun _ => le_rfl) D.cover₀
168	
169	/-- The quasi-coherence packaging on the pinned chart `V₁ᴮ`, from the chart-1
170	family. -/
171	noncomputable instance instQcohOn₁ :
172	    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
173	  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inr) (h := D.h₁)
174	    (fun _ => le_rfl) D.cover₁
175	
176	/-- The quasi-coherence packaging on the overlap of the pinned charts, from the
177	restricted chart-0 family (the subordinate-pieces interface). -/
178	noncomputable instance instQcohOnInf :
179	    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
180	      ((relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
181	  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle
182	    (σ := fun j : D.J₀ => Sum.inl j) (h := D.hInf)
183	    (fun j => D.basicOpen_hInf_le j) D.coverInf
184	
185	/-- **The two-cover pair data of the datum's glued sheaf** at the pinned relative chart
186	coordinates `t₀ᴮ, t₁ᴮ`: overlap-as-basic-open from the landed
187	`relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₀/₁`, mutual inverse from the pulled-back
188	`P1.chartCoord` relation `relFiberCoord_mul`. Its `pair` is the two-lattice pair of the
189	datum's sheaf that the rigid engine consumes. -/
190	noncomputable def pairData :
191	    Scheme.TwoCoverPairData D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
192	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
193	  gluedPairData B D.pieces D.unit
194	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
195	    (relFiberCoord₀ C B π) (relFiberCoord₁ C B π)
196	    (relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₀ C B π)
197	    (relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₁ C B π)
198	    (relFiberCoord_mul C B π)
199	
200	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
201	
202	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsToDivisors
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafClass
8	
9	/-!
10	# Sections to divisors — the LocalEquations construction and the class law (DAT-A)
11	
12	Worksheet §2.2 step 2, made literal (`informal/spec-dat-a.md` §3): a global section of
13	the DAT-1 glued sheaf **is** a matching family `(s_j)` with `s_i = g_{ij}·s_j`, so once
14	its components are germ-regular (DAT-A2, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsToDivisors`)
15	it is a `Scheme.LocalEquations` datum on the nose. The (1e) class law
16	(`Cohomology/GluedSheafClass.lean`, landed while this brick was in flight) is consumed
17	directly — the spec's `cocycleClassOn` seam is CLOSED, no interim class carrier exists:
18	
19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations` — the LocalEquations datum of a
20	  germ-regular global section on **any** pointed cover subordinated to the pieces
21	  (the (1e) subordination interface `𝒲, σ, hσ`): equations the restricted components
22	  `D.component s (σ y)`, ratio witnesses the subordinated transition units
23	  `gluedSubordUnit`;
24	* `sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit` — the ratio units are **exactly** the (restricted)
25	  transition units of the cocycle (`ratioUnit_unique`); on the piece cover the
26	  restriction is along `≤`-reflexivity, i.e. the units themselves;
27	* `sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle` — the units cocycle of the constructed datum is
28	  the (1e) subordinated cocycle `gluedSubordCocycle`;
29	* **the class law** `sectionLocalEquations_picClass`:
30	  `(D.sectionLocalEquations …).picClass = D.cechPicClass` — the divisor datum cut out
31	  by a germ-regular section presents THE class of the datum's cocycle (the Abel
32	  correspondence), through the landed `cechPicClass_eq_mk`. Naturality under
33	  refinement/subordination-choice is the landed `gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq`; unit
34	  rescalings and cover refinements of the constructed datum keep the class by the
35	  landed `LocalEquations.picClass_rescale`/`picClass_restrict`;
36	* `sectionLocalEquations_picClass_congr` — any two germ-regular sections on any two
37	  subordinated covers cut divisors of the same class;
38	* `sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular` — the A2-bundled wrapper on the canonical
39	  pointed cover (`D.pointedCover`): a fibrewise-regular global section yields the
40	  divisor datum outright, with class `D.cechPicClass` (`[IsNoetherianRing B]`).
41	-/
42	
43	set_option autoImplicit false
44	
45	universe u
46	
47	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
48	
49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
50	
51	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
52	
53	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
54	
55	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
56	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
57	
58	/-- The value of a restricted unit section is the restriction of its value. -/
59	private lemma val_unitsRestrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {W U : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U)
60	    (u : Γ(X, U)ˣ) :
61	    ((X.unitsRestrict h u : Γ(X, W)ˣ) : Γ(X, W)) = X.resHom h (u : Γ(X, U)) :=
62	  rfl
63	
64	section AffineHom
65	
66	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
67	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
68	variable (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
69	variable (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
70	variable (hσ : ∀ y : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ≤ D.pieces (σ y))
71	
72	/-- The defining ratio equation of the section's restricted components on the overlaps
73	of a subordinated pointed cover: the matching relation of the glued family, restricted
74	from `⊤ ⊓ Uᵢ ⊓ Uⱼ`. -/
75	private lemma component_ratio_eq (y y' : relCurve C B) :
76	    ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
77	        𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y)).op).hom
78	        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
79	      = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
80	            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
81	        * ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
82	            𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y')).op).hom
83	            ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y') (D.component s (σ y'))) := by
84	  have hle : 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'
85	      ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (σ y) ⊓ D.pieces (σ y') :=
86	    le_inf (le_inf le_top (inf_le_left.trans (hσ y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y'))
87	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom hle) (s.property (σ y) (σ y'))
88	  rw [map_mul] at key
89	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
90	  change (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left
91	      ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
92	    = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
93	        Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
94	      * (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right
95	          ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y') (D.component s (σ y')))
96	  rw [gluedSubordUnit, val_unitsRestrict, component, component]
97	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
98	  exact key
99	
100	/-- **Sections ↦ divisor families** (DAT-A, worksheet §2.2 step 2): a germ-regular
101	global section of the DAT-1 glued sheaf is a `Scheme.LocalEquations` datum on any
102	pointed cover subordinated to the pieces — the equations are the (restricted)
103	components, the ratio witnesses the subordinated transition units. Germ-regularity
104	(`hreg`) is DAT-A2's output (`germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors` relatively;
105	`Scheme.germ_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero` on an integral field-level curve). -/
106	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquations
107	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
108	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
109	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y)) :
110	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations where
111	  cover := 𝒲
112	  eqn y := (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y))
113	  regular y z hz := by
114	    rw [Scheme.resHom, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
115	    exact hreg (σ y) z (hσ y hz)
116	  ratio_isUnit y y' :=
117	    ⟨gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y', D.component_ratio_eq s 𝒲 σ hσ y y'⟩
118	
119	variable (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
120	  ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
121	    ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y))
122	
123	@[simp]
124	lemma sectionLocalEquations_cover :
125	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).cover = 𝒲 :=
126	  rfl
127	
128	@[simp]
129	lemma sectionLocalEquations_eqn (y : relCurve C B) :
130	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).eqn y
131	      = (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)) :=
132	  rfl
133	
134	/-- **The ratio units are exactly the cocycle's transition units** (worksheet §2.2 step
135	2's "ratio units EXACTLY the cocycle"), in subordinated form: by uniqueness of ratio
136	witnesses against a regular equation. On the piece cover the subordination is
137	`≤`-reflexivity and `gluedSubordUnit` is the transition unit restricted along it. -/
138	lemma sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit (y y' : relCurve C B) :
139	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).ratioUnit y y'
140	      = gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :=
141	  ((D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).ratioUnit_unique y y'
142	    (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y')
143	    (D.component_ratio_eq s 𝒲 σ hσ y y')).symm
144	
145	/-- The units cocycle of the constructed LocalEquations datum is the (1e) subordinated
146	cocycle of the datum. -/
147	lemma sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle :
148	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).unitsCocycle
149	      = gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 σ hσ :=
150	  Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun y y' =>
151	    ((D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).unitsCocycle_evInf y y').trans
152	      ((D.sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg y y').trans
153	        (gluedSubordCocycle_evInf D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 σ hσ y y').symm)
154	
155	/-- **THE CLASS LAW** (DAT-A keystone; the Abel correspondence of worksheet §2.2 step
156	2): the Picard class of the divisor datum cut out by a germ-regular global section of
157	the DAT-1 glued sheaf is THE Čech Picard class of the datum's cocycle (stage (1e),
158	consumed on the nose through `cechPicClass_eq_mk`). -/
159	theorem sectionLocalEquations_picClass :
160	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).picClass = D.cechPicClass := by
161	  change Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲
162	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).unitsCocycle.class = D.cechPicClass
163	  rw [D.sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg]
164	  exact D.cechPicClass_eq_mk 𝒲 σ hσ
165	
166	end AffineHom
167	
168	/-- **Independence of the section and the cover** (refinement/rescaling naturality,
169	subsumed): the class of the divisor datum cut by ANY germ-regular section of the datum,
170	on ANY subordinated pointed cover, is the same — both are `D.cechPicClass`. Unit
171	rescalings and cover refinements of the constructed datum keep the class by the landed
172	`LocalEquations.picClass_rescale`/`picClass_restrict`. -/
173	theorem sectionLocalEquations_picClass_congr
174	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
175	    (s s' : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
176	    (𝒲 𝒲' : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ σ' : relCurve C B → D.index)
177	    (hσ : ∀ y : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ≤ D.pieces (σ y))
178	    (hσ' : ∀ y : relCurve C B, 𝒲'.opens y ≤ D.pieces (σ' y))
179	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
180	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
181	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y))
182	    (hreg' : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
183	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s' j)
184	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y)) :
185	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).picClass
186	      = (D.sectionLocalEquations s' 𝒲' σ' hσ' hreg').picClass := by
187	  rw [D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg,
188	    D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s' 𝒲' σ' hσ' hreg']
189	
190	/-! ## The A2-bundled wrapper, on the canonical pointed cover -/
191	
192	section Bundled
193	
194	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
195	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
196	
197	/-- **Fibrewise-nonzero sections cut divisors** (DAT-A + DAT-A2, bundled): over a
198	Noetherian test ring, a fibrewise-regular global section of the DAT-1 glued sheaf
199	yields a `LocalEquations` divisor datum on the canonical pointed cover by pieces; its
200	class is `D.cechPicClass` (`sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass`). -/
201	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
202	    [IsNoetherianRing B]
203	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
204	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
205	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
206	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations :=
207	  D.sectionLocalEquations s D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl)
208	    (fun j y hy => D.germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors s j (hfib j) y hy)
209	
210	/-- The class law for the A2-bundled wrapper: the fibrewise-regular section cuts a
211	divisor of class exactly the datum's (1e) class. -/
212	theorem sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass
213	    [IsNoetherianRing B]
214	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
215	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
216	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
217	    (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).picClass = D.cechPicClass :=
218	  D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl) _
219	
220	end Bundled
221	
222	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
223	
224	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic
7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks
8	
9	/-!
10	# The relative Picard functor of a curve
11	
12	For a scheme `C` over a field `k` (an object of `Over (Spec k)`) this file defines the
13	relative Picard functor of Grothendieck–Kleiman:
14	$$\operatorname{Pic}_{C/k}(T) \;=\; \operatorname{Pic}(C \times_k T)\,/\,
15	  \operatorname{Pic}(T),$$
16	line-bundle classes on `C ⊗ T` modulo classes pulled back from the test object `T`
17	along the second projection. The quotient — never the absolute `Pic(C ⊗ T)`, which is
18	not even a separated presheaf in any useful sense — is the functor that étale
19	sheafification and the representability theorem consume.
20	
21	Products are the cartesian-monoidal product of `Over (Spec k)` (chosen pullbacks of
22	schemes): `C ⊗ T`, projection `snd C T`, whiskering `C ◁ g`, matching the vocabulary
23	of the challenge statement file.
24	
25	## Main declarations
26	
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picFromBase C T`: the subgroup of `(C ⊗ T).left.CechPic` of classes
28	  pulled back from `T` along the second projection.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPic C T`: the relative Picard group, the quotient by
30	  `picFromBase C T`, a `CommGroup`; `relPicMk` is the projection, with
31	  `relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff` the exact coset relation (a genuine range condition, no
32	  choice, no `Nonempty (≅)`).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicMap C g`: restriction along `g : T' ⟶ T`, descended from
34	  pullback of Čech classes along `C ◁ g`.
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicFunctor C`: the relative Picard functor
36	  `(Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat`.
37	-/
38	
39	set_option autoImplicit false
40	
41	universe u
42	
43	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
44	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
49	
50	noncomputable section
51	
52	/-- The subgroup of Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` pulled back from the test object `T`
53	along the second projection. The relative Picard group is the quotient by it. -/
54	def picFromBase (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subgroup ((C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :=
55	  (CechPic.map (snd C T).left).range
56	
57	lemma mem_picFromBase_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
58	    L ∈ picFromBase C T ↔ ∃ N : T.left.CechPic, CechPic.map (snd C T).left N = L :=
59	  Iff.rfl
60	
61	/-- The relative Picard group of `C/k` at a test object `T`: Picard classes on `C ⊗ T`
62	modulo classes pulled back from `T`. -/
63	def relPic (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
64	  (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic ⧸ picFromBase C T
65	
66	noncomputable instance (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : CommGroup (relPic C T) :=
67	  QuotientGroup.Quotient.commGroup (picFromBase C T)
68	
69	/-- The projection from Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` to the relative Picard group. -/
70	noncomputable def relPicMk (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
71	    (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic →* relPic C T :=
72	  QuotientGroup.mk' (picFromBase C T)
73	
74	lemma relPicMk_surjective (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
75	    Function.Surjective (relPicMk C T) :=
76	  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (picFromBase C T)
77	
78	/-- The exact coset relation: two Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` have equal image in the
79	relative Picard group iff their ratio is pulled back from `T`. -/
80	lemma relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
81	    {L L' : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
82	    relPicMk C T L = relPicMk C T L' ↔ L / L' ∈ picFromBase C T :=
83	  QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem
84	
85	@[elab_as_elim]
86	theorem relPic.ind {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {motive : relPic C T → Prop}
87	    (mk : ∀ L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic, motive (relPicMk C T L)) (x : relPic C T) :
88	    motive x :=
89	  QuotientGroup.induction_on x mk
90	
91	variable {T T' T'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
92	
93	/-- Pullback of Čech Picard classes along `C ◁ g` sends classes from `T` to classes
94	from `T'`: the well-definedness of `relPicMap` on the `H_T`-cosets. -/
95	lemma picFromBase_le_comap (g : T' ⟶ T) :
96	    picFromBase C T ≤ (picFromBase C T').comap (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left) := by
97	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
98	  refine ⟨CechPic.map g.left N, ?_⟩
99	  show CechPic.map (snd C T').left (CechPic.map g.left N)
100	      = CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left (CechPic.map (snd C T).left N)
101	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
102	    ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whiskerLeft_snd]
103	
104	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along `g : T' ⟶ T`: pull back along
105	`C ◁ g` and descend to the quotients. -/
106	noncomputable def relPicMap (g : T' ⟶ T) : relPic C T →* relPic C T' :=
107	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C T')
108	    (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left) (picFromBase_le_comap C g)
109	
110	@[simp]
111	lemma relPicMap_mk (g : T' ⟶ T) (L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :
112	    relPicMap C g (relPicMk C T L) = relPicMk C T' (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left L) :=
113	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
114	
115	lemma relPicMap_id (x : relPic C T) : relPicMap C (𝟙 T) x = x := by
116	  induction x using relPic.ind with
117	  | mk L =>
118	    rw [relPicMap_mk, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Over.id_left,
119	      Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
120	    rfl
121	
122	lemma relPicMap_comp (g : T' ⟶ T) (h : T'' ⟶ T') (x : relPic C T) :
123	    relPicMap C (h ≫ g) x = relPicMap C h (relPicMap C g x) := by
124	  induction x using relPic.ind with
125	  | mk L =>
126	    rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMap_mk, relPicMap_mk]
127	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C T'') ?_
128	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
129	      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
130	
131	/-- The relative Picard functor `T ↦ Pic(C ⊗ T)/Pic(T)` of Grothendieck–Kleiman, as a
132	presheaf of commutative groups on `Over (Spec k)`. -/
133	noncomputable def relPicFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} where
134	  obj T := CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop)
135	  map g := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMap C g.unop)
136	  map_id T := by
137	    ext x
138	    exact relPicMap_id C x
139	  map_comp g h := by
140	    ext x
141	    exact relPicMap_comp C g.unop h.unop x
142	
143	@[simp]
144	lemma relPicFunctor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
145	    (relPicFunctor C).obj T = CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop) :=
146	  rfl
147	
148	@[simp]
149	lemma relPicFunctor_map {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')
150	    (x : relPic C T.unop) :
151	    (relPicFunctor C).map g x = relPicMap C g.unop x :=
152	  rfl
153	
154	/-! ## Naturality in the curve -/
155	
156	variable {C} {C' C'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
157	
158	/-- Pullback of Čech classes along `g ▷ T` sends classes pulled back from `T` to classes
159	pulled back from `T`: well-definedness of the curve-direction map on the `H_T`-cosets. -/
160	lemma picFromBase_le_comap_whiskerRight (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
161	    picFromBase C T ≤ (picFromBase C' T).comap (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) := by
162	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
163	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
164	  show CechPic.map (snd C' T).left N
165	      = CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left (CechPic.map (snd C T).left N)
166	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
167	    whiskerRight_snd]
168	
169	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along a morphism of curves `g : C' ⟶ C`,
170	at a fixed test object: pull back along `g ▷ T` and descend to the quotients. -/
171	noncomputable def relPicMapCurveApp (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
172	    relPic C T →* relPic C' T :=
173	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C' T)
174	    (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) (picFromBase_le_comap_whiskerRight g T)
175	
176	@[simp]
177	lemma relPicMapCurveApp_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
178	    (L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :
179	    relPicMapCurveApp g T (relPicMk C T L)
180	      = relPicMk C' T (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left L) :=
181	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
182	
183	/-- Naturality of the relative Picard functor in the curve: a morphism of curves
184	`g : C' ⟶ C` induces a natural transformation `Pic_{C/k} ⟶ Pic_{C'/k}`. -/
185	noncomputable def relPicMapCurve (g : C' ⟶ C) :
186	    relPicFunctor C ⟶ relPicFunctor C' where
187	  app T := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop)
188	  naturality T T' t := by
189	    ext x
190	    induction x using relPic.ind with
191	    | mk L =>
192	      show relPicMapCurveApp g T'.unop (relPicMap C t.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
193	          = relPicMap C' t.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
194	      rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMap_mk]
195	      refine congrArg (relPicMk C' T'.unop) ?_
196	      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
197	        ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whisker_exchange]
198	
199	@[simp]
200	lemma relPicMapCurve_app_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ)
201	    (L : (C ⊗ T.unop).left.CechPic) :
202	    (relPicMapCurve g).app T (relPicMk C T.unop L)
203	      = relPicMk C' T.unop (CechPic.map (g ▷ T.unop).left L) :=
204	  relPicMapCurveApp_mk g T.unop L
205	
206	/-- The curve-direction maps are strictly functorial: the identity morphism induces the
207	identity transformation. -/
208	lemma relPicMapCurve_id : relPicMapCurve (𝟙 C) = 𝟙 (relPicFunctor C) := by
209	  ext T x
210	  induction x using relPic.ind with
211	  | mk L =>
212	    show relPicMapCurveApp (𝟙 C) T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L) = relPicMk C T.unop L
213	    rw [relPicMapCurveApp_mk, MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight, Over.id_left,
214	      Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
215	    rfl
216	
217	/-- The curve-direction maps are strictly functorial: composition of curve morphisms
218	goes to composition of the induced transformations (contravariantly). -/
219	lemma relPicMapCurve_comp (g' : C'' ⟶ C') (g : C' ⟶ C) :
220	    relPicMapCurve (g' ≫ g) = relPicMapCurve g ≫ relPicMapCurve g' := by
221	  ext T x
222	  induction x using relPic.ind with
223	  | mk L =>
224	    show relPicMapCurveApp (g' ≫ g) T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L)
225	        = relPicMapCurveApp g' T.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
226	    rw [relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk]
227	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C'' T.unop) ?_
228	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
229	      ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight]
230	
231	end
232	
233	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	/-!
11	# The Čech Picard class of a gluing cocycle (DAT-1, stage 1e — the class law)
12	
13	The class law of `informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1e): a gluing cocycle on pieces
14	`U : J → X.Opens` determines a class in the definitional Picard group
15	`Scheme.CechPic` on every pointed cover subordinated to the pieces, independently of
16	the subordination; for the pinned basic-open cocycle datum the pieces cover the
17	relative curve, giving **the** class of the datum, natural in the test ring.
18	
19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordCocycle` — the unit Čech 1-cocycle induced on a
20	  pointed cover `𝒲` subordinated to the pieces (`σ : X → J`,
21	  `hσ : 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)`): pair values the restricted transition units.
22	* `gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq` — **subordination independence**: any two subordinated
23	  pointed covers give the same `CechPic` class (restrict to the common refinement; the
24	  two restricted cocycles are cohomologous through the `0`-cochain
25	  `x ↦ g (σ' x) (σ x)`, by the cocycle law).
26	* `gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous_of_coboundary` — cohomologous gluing cocycles
27	  (`Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary`) induce cohomologous subordinated cocycles, hence equal
28	  classes (`gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq_of_coboundary`) — the class-level face of the
29	  landed sheaf-level transport `gluedSheafCongr`.
30	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass` — the class of the pinned datum (worksheet
31	  §3.2), on the canonical pointed cover by pieces; `cechPicClass_eq_mk` re-expresses it
32	  on **any** subordinated pointed cover (the interface the stage-(1f) extraction and
33	  DAT-3 consume).
34	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange` — **naturality in the test ring**:
35	  the class of the base-changed datum is the `CechPic.map`-pullback of the class along
36	  `relCurveMap C B B'`.
37	-/

51	/-! ## The subordinated unit cocycle of a gluing cocycle -/
52	
53	section Subord
54	
55	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u} {U : J → X.Opens}
56	variable {g g' : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ}
57	
58	/-- The underlying section of a restricted unit is the restricted underlying section. -/
59	private lemma coe_unitsRestrict {W U₀ : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U₀) (u : Γ(X, U₀)ˣ) :
60	    (X.unitsRestrict h u : Γ(X, W)) = X.resHom h (u : Γ(X, U₀)) :=
61	  rfl
62	
63	/-- The pair value of the subordinated cocycle: the transition unit `g (σ x) (σ y)`
64	restricted to the overlap `𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y` of the subordinated cover. -/
65	noncomputable def gluedSubordUnit (g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover)
66	    (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) (x y : X) :
67	    Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)ˣ :=
68	  X.unitsRestrict
69	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)) :
70	      𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ x) ⊓ U (σ y))
71	    (g (σ x) (σ y))
72	
73	/-- The cocycle identity for the subordinated pair values, in unit-section language
74	(the shape `PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.ofPairs` consumes). -/
75	lemma gluedSubordUnit_trans (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover)
76	    (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) (x y z : X) :
77	    X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
78	          𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
79	        (gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y)
80	      * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right :
81	          𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z)
82	          (gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ y z)
83	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
84	          𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens z)
85	          (gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x z) := by
86	  have hO : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ U (σ x) ⊓ U (σ y) ⊓ U (σ z) :=
87	    le_inf (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans (hσ x))
88	      ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hσ y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ z))
89	  refine Units.ext ?_
90	  rw [Units.val_mul, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict,
91	    gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
92	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
93	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
94	  exact hc.mul_res_of_le hO
95	
96	/-- **The subordinated unit Čech cocycle** of a gluing cocycle: on a pointed cover
97	subordinated to the pieces, the restricted transition units form a unit 1-cocycle. -/
98	noncomputable def gluedSubordCocycle (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
99	    (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
100	    X.unitsCocycle 𝒲 :=
101	  OneCocycle.ofPairs (G := X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
102	    (U := 𝒲.opens) (fun x y => gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y)
103	    (fun x y z => gluedSubordUnit_trans hc 𝒲 σ hσ x y z)
104	
105	@[simp]
106	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_evInf (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover)
107	    (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) (x y : X) :
108	    Scheme.unitsEvInf (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ) x y =
109	      gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y :=
110	  OneCocycle.ofPairs_evInf (G := X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
111	    (U := 𝒲.opens) (fun x y => gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y)
112	    (fun x y z => gluedSubordUnit_trans hc 𝒲 σ hσ x y z) x y
113	
114	/-- Restricting the subordinated cocycle to a refinement gives the subordinated cocycle
115	of the refinement (with the induced subordination). -/
116	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_res (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) {𝒲' 𝒲 : X.PointedCover}
117	    (h : 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲) (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
118	    (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).res (fun x => homOfLE (h x)) =
119	      gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲' σ (fun x => (h x).trans (hσ x)) := by
120	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
121	  rw [Scheme.res_unitsEvInf h (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ) x y,
122	    gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf]
123	  refine Units.ext ?_
124	  rw [coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
125	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
126	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
127	
128	/-- **Two subordinations of the same cover give cohomologous cocycles**, through the
129	`0`-cochain `x ↦ g (σ' x) (σ x)` (the cocycle law makes the coboundary law hold). -/
130	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
131	    (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ σ' : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x))
132	    (hσ' : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ' x)) :
133	    (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).IsCohomologous (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ' hσ') := by
134	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_isCohomologous
135	    (fun x => X.unitsRestrict (le_inf (hσ' x) (hσ x) : 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ' x) ⊓ U (σ x))
136	      (g (σ' x) (σ x))) (fun x y => ?_)
137	  refine Units.ext ?_
138	  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
139	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
140	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
141	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
142	  have hL : X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)))
143	        ((inf_le_left.trans (hσ x))) :
144	        𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ' x) ⊓ U (σ x)) (g (σ' x) (σ x) : Γ(X, _)) *
145	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
146	        (g (σ x) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) =
147	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
148	        (g (σ' x) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) :=
149	    hc.mul_res_of_le (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x))
150	      (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
151	  have hR : X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)))
152	        ((inf_le_right.trans (hσ' y))) :
153	        𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ' x) ⊓ U (σ' y)) (g (σ' x) (σ' y) : Γ(X, _)) *
154	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans (hσ' y)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
155	        (g (σ' y) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) =
156	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
157	        (g (σ' x) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) :=
158	    hc.mul_res_of_le (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x))
159	      (inf_le_right.trans (hσ' y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
160	  exact hL.trans hR.symm
161	
162	/-- **Subordination independence of the class**: any two pointed covers subordinated to
163	the pieces of a gluing cocycle carry the same `CechPic` class. -/
164	theorem gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
165	    (𝒲 𝒲' : X.PointedCover) (σ σ' : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x))
166	    (hσ' : ∀ x : X, 𝒲'.opens x ≤ U (σ' x)) :
167	    Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
168	      Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲' (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲' σ' hσ').class := by
169	  refine Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲', inf_le_left, inf_le_right, ?_⟩
170	  have h₁ : Scheme.unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲)
171	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
172	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc (𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲') σ
173	        (fun x => ((inf_le_left : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲) x).trans (hσ x))).class :=
174	    congrArg OneCocycle.class
175	      (gluedSubordCocycle_res hc (inf_le_left : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲) σ hσ)
176	  have h₂ : Scheme.unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲')
177	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲' σ' hσ').class =
178	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc (𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲') σ'
179	        (fun x => ((inf_le_right : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲') x).trans (hσ' x))).class :=
180	    congrArg OneCocycle.class
181	      (gluedSubordCocycle_res hc (inf_le_right : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲') σ' hσ')
182	  rw [h₁, h₂]
183	  exact (gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous hc (𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲') σ σ' _ _).class_eq
184	
185	/-- **Cohomologous gluing cocycles induce cohomologous subordinated cocycles**: a
186	gluing coboundary `c` between multiplier families restricts to a Čech coboundary
187	between the subordinated cocycles — the class-level face of the sheaf-level transport
188	`gluedSheafCongr`. -/
189	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous_of_coboundary (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
190	    (hc' : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g') {c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ}
191	    (hcob : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ : X → J)
192	    (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
193	    (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).IsCohomologous (gluedSubordCocycle hc' 𝒲 σ hσ) := by
194	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_isCohomologous
195	    (fun x => X.unitsRestrict (hσ x) (c (σ x))) (fun x y => ?_)
196	  refine Units.ext ?_
197	  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
198	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
199	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
200	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
201	  have key := congrArg
202	    (X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)) :
203	      𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ x) ⊓ U (σ y))) (hcob (σ x) (σ y))
204	  rw [map_mul, map_mul] at key
205	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
206	  exact key
207	
208	/-- Cohomologous gluing cocycles give equal `CechPic` classes on every subordinated
209	pointed cover. -/
210	theorem gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq_of_coboundary (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
211	    (hc' : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g') {c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ}
212	    (hcob : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ : X → J)
213	    (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
214	    Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
215	      Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle hc' 𝒲 σ hσ).class :=
216	  congrArg (Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲)
217	    (gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous_of_coboundary hc hc' hcob 𝒲 σ hσ).class_eq
218	
219	end Subord

221	/-! ## The class of the pinned cocycle datum -/
222	
223	section Datum
224	
225	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
226	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
227	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
228	
229	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
230	
231	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
232	
233	/-- Every point of the relative curve lies in a piece of the datum: the two pinned
234	charts cover the curve and each chart is covered by its basic-open pieces. -/
235	lemma exists_mem_pieces (x : relCurve C B) : ∃ j : D.index, x ∈ D.pieces j := by
236	  have hx : x ∈ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊔ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
237	    rw [relCover_sup]
238	    trivial
239	  rcases (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup).mp hx with h0 | h1
240	  · have hcov := D.cover₀ h0
241	    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
242	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
243	    exact ⟨Sum.inl j, hj⟩
244	  · have hcov := D.cover₁ h1
245	    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
246	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
247	    exact ⟨Sum.inr j, hj⟩
248	
249	/-- A choice of piece through every point of the relative curve. -/
250	noncomputable def pieceIndex (x : relCurve C B) : D.index :=
251	  (D.exists_mem_pieces x).choose
252	
253	lemma mem_pieces_pieceIndex (x : relCurve C B) : x ∈ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
254	  (D.exists_mem_pieces x).choose_spec
255	
256	/-- **The canonical pointed cover by pieces** of the datum. -/
257	noncomputable def pointedCover : (relCurve C B).PointedCover where
258	  opens x := D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x)
259	  mem_opens x := D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x
260	
261	@[simp]
262	lemma pointedCover_opens (x : relCurve C B) :
263	    D.pointedCover.opens x = D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) := rfl
264	
265	/-- **The Čech Picard class of the pinned cocycle datum** (stage 1e): the class of the
266	subordinated unit cocycle on the canonical pointed cover by pieces. By
267	`cechPicClass_eq_mk` it is computed by **any** pointed cover subordinated to the
268	pieces. -/
269	noncomputable def cechPicClass : (relCurve C B).CechPic :=
270	  Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
271	    (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
272	      (fun _ => le_rfl)).class
273	
274	/-- **The class law on subordinated covers**: the class of the datum is computed by the
275	subordinated cocycle on any pointed cover subordinated to the pieces (the interface the
276	stage-(1f) extraction and DAT-3 consume). -/
277	theorem cechPicClass_eq_mk (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
278	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x)) :
279	    Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
280	      D.cechPicClass :=
281	  gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 D.pointedCover σ D.pieceIndex hσ
282	    (fun _ => le_rfl)
283	
284	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

286	/-! ## Naturality of the class in the test ring -/
287	
288	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
289	
290	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
291	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
292	
293	/-- The pullback of the canonical pointed cover is subordinated to the pieces of the
294	base-changed datum (pieces base-change to pieces). -/
295	lemma pullback_pointedCover_le (x : relCurve C B') :
296	    (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x ≤
297	      (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) := by
298	  rw [Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, pointedCover_opens]
299	  exact (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B'
300	    (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))).ge
301	
302	/-- (Implementation) **The pulled-back subordinated cocycle is the subordinated cocycle
303	of the base-changed datum**: comparing pair values, both are one `appLE` of the
304	transition unit. -/
305	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_gluedSubordCocycle :
306	    (relCurveMap C B B').pullbackUnitsCocycle
307	      (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
308	        (fun _ => le_rfl)) =
309	    gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle
310	      (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
311	      (fun x => D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
312	      (fun x => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x) := by
313	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
314	  rw [Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
315	    gluedSubordCocycle_evInf]
316	  refine Units.ext ?_
317	  rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_unitsAppLE, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
318	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
319	  -- left side: `appLE` of the restricted unit collapses to one `appLE`
320	  have hL := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
321	    $(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (relCurveMap C B B')
322	      ((relCurveMap C B B').le_preimage_inf
323	        (inf_le_left : (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x ⊓
324	          (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y ≤
325	            (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x)
326	        (inf_le_right))
327	      (homOfLE (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans le_rfl) (inf_le_right.trans le_rfl) :
328	        D.pointedCover.opens ((relCurveMap C B B').base x) ⊓
329	          D.pointedCover.opens ((relCurveMap C B B').base y) ≤
330	            D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
331	              D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)))).op))
332	    ((D.unit (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
333	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)) :
334	      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
335	        D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y))))))
336	  -- right side: restriction of the base-changed unit collapses to one `appLE`
337	  have hR := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
338	    $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (relCurveMap C B B')
339	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B'
340	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
341	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)))
342	      (homOfLE (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x))
343	        (inf_le_right.trans (D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' y)) :
344	        (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x ⊓
345	          (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y ≤
346	            (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
347	              (D.baseChange B').pieces
348	                (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)))).op))
349	    ((D.unit (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
350	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)) :
351	      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
352	        D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y))))))
353	  exact hL.trans hR.symm
354	
355	/-- **Naturality of the class in the test ring** (stage 1e, last clause): the Čech
356	Picard class of the base-changed datum is the pullback of the class of the datum along
357	the relative-curve comparison morphism. -/
358	theorem cechPicClass_baseChange :
359	    (D.baseChange B').cechPicClass =
360	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B B') D.cechPicClass := by
361	  calc (D.baseChange B').cechPicClass
362	      = Scheme.CechPic.mk (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
363	          (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle
364	            (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
365	            (fun x => D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
366	            (fun x => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x)).class :=
367	        ((D.baseChange B').cechPicClass_eq_mk
368	          (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
369	          (fun x => D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
370	          (fun x => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x)).symm
371	    _ = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B B') D.cechPicClass := by
372	        rw [← D.pullbackUnitsCocycle_gluedSubordCocycle B']
373	        rfl
374	
375	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
376	
377	end Datum

8	/-!
9	# The definitional Picard group: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf
10	
11	For a scheme `X`, this file defines the Picard group of record of this development:
12	the Čech cohomology `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` on the small Zariski site, computed on **pointed
13	covers** (one open per point of `X`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle`) and
14	stabilized along the refinement preorder.
15	
16	## Main declarations
17	
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic`: the Picard group `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` as the quotient
19	  of `Σ 𝒰, X.unitsH1 𝒰` by agreement on a common refinement, with its `CommGroup`
20	  structure and the constructor/eliminator API `CechPic.mk`, `CechPic.ind`,
21	  `CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff`, `CechPic.mk_unitsRes`, `CechPic.mk_mul_mk_inf`.
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.map`: contravariant functoriality — for
23	  `f : X ⟶ Y` the pullback `Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic` — with the strict functor laws
24	  `CechPic.map_id` and `CechPic.map_comp` (the lane keystone).
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.subsingleton_of_subsingleton`: on a scheme with a
26	  subsingleton underlying space (e.g. `Spec` of a field) the Picard group is trivial.
27	-/
28	
29	set_option autoImplicit false
30	
31	universe u
32	
33	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
34	
35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
36	
37	namespace Scheme
38	
39	variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
40	
41	/-! ## The Picard group  -/
42	
43	instance cechPicSetoid (X : Scheme.{u}) : Setoid (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) where
44	  r p q := ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1),
45	    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2
46	  iseqv := by
47	    constructor
48	    · exact fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩
49	    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
50	      exact ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩
51	    · rintro p q r ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩
52	      refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, inf_le_right.trans h₄, ?_⟩
53	      have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
54	      have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
55	      simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
56	      exact e₁'.trans e₂'
57	
58	/-- The definitional Picard group of a scheme: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf,
59	stabilized along refinement of pointed covers. -/
60	def CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
61	  Quotient (cechPicSetoid X)
62	
63	namespace CechPic
64	
65	/-- The Picard class of a unit Čech `H¹` class on a pointed cover. -/
66	def mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : X.CechPic :=
67	  ⟦⟨𝒰, a⟩⟧
68	
69	@[elab_as_elim]
70	theorem ind {motive : X.CechPic → Prop}
71	    (mk : ∀ (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰), motive (mk 𝒰 a)) (x : X.CechPic) :
72	    motive x :=
73	  Quotient.ind (fun p ↦ by obtain ⟨𝒰, a⟩ := p; exact mk 𝒰 a) x
74	
75	theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} {a : X.unitsH1 𝒰} {b : X.unitsH1 𝒱} :
76	    mk 𝒰 a = mk 𝒱 b ↔
77	      ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱),
78	        unitsRes h₁ a = unitsRes h₂ b :=
79	  Quotient.eq
80	
81	/-- Two classes agreeing after restriction to a common refinement are equal; in
82	particular `mk` is invariant under restriction. -/
83	@[simp]
84	theorem mk_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
85	    mk 𝒱 (unitsRes h a) = mk 𝒰 a :=
86	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒱, le_rfl, h, unitsRes_rfl _⟩
87	
88	private def mulSig (p q : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
89	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
90	  ⟨p.1 ⊓ q.1, unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2⟩
91	
92	private lemma mulSig_assoc {𝒰 𝒱 𝒳 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱)
93	    (c : X.unitsH1 𝒳) :
94	    mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳)
95	        (unitsRes inf_le_left (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) *
96	          unitsRes inf_le_right c)
97	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳))
98	        (unitsRes inf_le_left a *
99	          unitsRes inf_le_right (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right c)) := by
100	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳, le_rfl, (inf_assoc 𝒰 𝒱 𝒳).le, ?_⟩
101	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
102	  exact mul_assoc _ _ _
103	
104	private lemma mulSig_compat {p p' q q' : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰}
105	    (hp : p ≈ p') (hq : q ≈ q') : mulSig p q ≈ mulSig p' q' := by
106	  obtain ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ := hp
107	  obtain ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩ := hq
108	  have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
109	  have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
110	  simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
111	  refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_inf h₁ h₃, inf_le_inf h₂ h₄, ?_⟩
112	  show unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₁ h₃) (unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2)
113	      = unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₂ h₄) (unitsRes inf_le_left p'.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q'.2)
114	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes]
115	  rw [e₁', e₂']
116	
117	instance : CommGroup X.CechPic where
118	  mul := Quotient.map₂ mulSig (fun _ _ hp _ _ hq ↦ mulSig_compat hp hq)
119	  one := mk ⊤ 1
120	  inv := Quotient.map (fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, p.2⁻¹⟩) (by
121	    rintro p p' ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
122	    exact ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, by simp only [map_inv, e]⟩)
123	  mul_assoc a b c := by
124	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
125	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
126	    induction c using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒳 c =>
127	    exact mulSig_assoc a b c
128	  one_mul a := by
129	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
130	    show mk (⊤ ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤) * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
131	      = mk 𝒰 a
132	    rw [map_one, one_mul, mk_unitsRes]
133	  mul_one a := by
134	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
135	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ ⊤) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤))
136	      = mk 𝒰 a
137	    rw [map_one, mul_one, mk_unitsRes]
138	  inv_mul_cancel a := by
139	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
140	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left a⁻¹ * unitsRes inf_le_right a) = mk ⊤ 1
141	    have h : unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a⁻¹
142	        * unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a = 1 := by
143	      rw [map_inv]
144	      exact inv_mul_cancel _
145	    rw [h]
146	    exact Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
147	  mul_comm a b := by
148	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
149	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
150	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b)
151	      = mk (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
152	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, le_rfl, le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_left, ?_⟩
153	    simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
154	    exact mul_comm _ _
155	
156	lemma one_def : (1 : X.CechPic) = mk ⊤ 1 :=
157	  rfl
158	
159	/-- Multiplication of Picard classes on representatives: restrict both to the common
160	refinement `𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱` and multiply there. Holds by definition. -/
161	lemma mk_mul_mk_inf {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱) :
162	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒱 b
163	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) :=
164	  rfl
165	
166	@[simp]
167	lemma mk_one (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : mk 𝒰 (1 : X.unitsH1 𝒰) = 1 :=
168	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
169	
170	@[simp]
171	lemma mk_mul_mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a b : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
172	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒰 b = mk 𝒰 (a * b) := by
173	  rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
174	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, inf_le_left, ?_⟩
175	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_rfl]
176	
177	@[simp]
178	lemma mk_inv (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : (mk 𝒰 a)⁻¹ = mk 𝒰 a⁻¹ :=
179	  rfl
180	
181	/-! ## Functoriality: pullback of Picard classes -/
182	
183	private def mapSig (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
184	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
185	  ⟨p.1.pullback f, f.pullbackUnitsH1 p.1 p.2⟩
186	
187	private lemma mapSig_compat (f : X ⟶ Y) :
188	    ∀ {p q : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰}, p ≈ q → mapSig f p ≈ mapSig f q := by
189	  rintro ⟨𝒰, a⟩ ⟨𝒱, b⟩ ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
190	  refine ⟨𝒲.pullback f, PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁,
191	    PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂, ?_⟩
192	  show unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
193	      = unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
194	  rw [Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₁ a, Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₂ b, e]

196	/-- Contravariant functoriality of the Čech Picard group: pull the cover back pointwise,
197	pull the unit cocycles back through `f`, restrict. -/
198	def map (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic where
199	  toFun := Quotient.map (mapSig f) fun _ _ h ↦ mapSig_compat f h
200	  map_one' := by
201	    show mk ((⊤ : Y.PointedCover).pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 ⊤ 1) = 1
202	    rw [map_one, mk_one]
203	  map_mul' a b := by
204	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
205	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
206	    show mk ((𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f)
207	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b))
208	      = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) *
209	          mk (𝒱.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
210	    rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
211	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f, le_rfl,
212	      le_inf (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_left)
213	        (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_right), ?_⟩
214	    simp only [map_mul, ← Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]

217	lemma map_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (a : Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
218	    map f (mk 𝒰 a) = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) :=
219	  rfl

221	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along the identity is the identity. -/
222	@[simp]
223	theorem map_id (X : Scheme.{u}) : map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id X.CechPic := by
224	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
225	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
226	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X)) ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) = mk 𝒰 a
227	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X) ≤ 𝒰 := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
228	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
229	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
230	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
231	  ext x y T a b
232	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
233	    γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf]
234	  exact id_unitsAppLE _ _

236	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along a composite (the lane keystone). -/
237	theorem map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : map (f ≫ g) = (map f).comp (map g) := by
238	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
239	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
240	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g)) ((f ≫ g).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
241	    = mk ((𝒰.pullback g).pullback f)
242	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰.pullback g) (g.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a))
243	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g) ≤ (𝒰.pullback g).pullback f := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
244	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
245	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
246	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
247	  ext x y T a b
248	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
249	    Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE]
250	  rfl

252	/-! ## Sanity gate: triviality over a field -/
253	
254	/-- On a scheme with a subsingleton underlying space — e.g. `Spec` of a field — the
255	Čech Picard group is trivial: every pointed cover is a cover by a single open, on which
256	every unit cocycle is a coboundary. -/
257	instance subsingleton_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] :
258	    Subsingleton X.CechPic := by
259	  refine ⟨fun p q ↦ ?_⟩
260	  induction p using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
261	  induction q using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
262	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, inf_le_left, inf_le_right, ?_⟩
263	  have := H1.subsingleton_of_forall_le (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
264	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens (fun i j ↦ le_of_eq (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim i j)))
265	  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
266	
267	/-- The Čech Picard group of the spectrum of a field is trivial. -/
268	theorem eq_one_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] (x : X.CechPic) :
269	    x = 1 :=
270	  Subsingleton.elim x 1
271	
272	example {K : Type u} [Field K] (x : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).CechPic) : x = 1 :=
273	  eq_one_of_subsingleton _ x
274	
275	end CechPic

10	
11	An invertible module over an affine open becomes free after inverting one element
12	avoiding any prescribed finite family of primes.  Applied to the germ primes of a
13	finite set of points, this gives a smaller affine open containing the whole set on
14	which a prescribed Cech Picard class is trivial.
15	
16	This is the coordinate-free principalization input for divisor-family
17	representability: first put a finite residue-fibre support in an affine open, then
18	trivialize the divisor line bundle near every point of that fibre at once.

32	/-- A Cech Picard class is trivial on an affine subneighbourhood of any finite set
33	contained in an affine open. -/
34	theorem exists_affineOpen_finset_subset_cechPicMap_ι_eq_one
35	    (L : X.CechPic) {F : Set X} (hF : F.Finite)
36	    {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hFW : F ⊆ (W : Set X)) :
37	    ∃ V : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ F ⊆ (V : Set X) ∧ V ≤ W ∧
38	      CechPic.map V.ι L = 1 := by
39	  classical
40	  let q : F → Ideal Γ(X, W) := fun z =>
41	    Ideal.comap ((X.presheaf.germ W z.1 (hFW z.2)).hom)
42	      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk z.1))
43	  letI : Finite F := hF.to_subtype
44	  letI : ∀ z : F, (q z).IsPrime := fun z => Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
45	  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfree⟩ := Module.Invertible.exists_notMem_isUnit_free
46	    (W.cechPicClass hW L).AsModule q
47	  refine ⟨X.basicOpen f, hW.basicOpen f, ?_, X.basicOpen_le f, ?_⟩
48	  · intro x hx
49	    apply (Scheme.mem_basicOpen X f x (hFW hx)).2
50	    by_contra hnu
51	    exact hf ⟨x, hx⟩ (by
52	      change ((X.presheaf.germ W x (hFW hx)).hom f) ∈
53	        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
54	      exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr hnu))
55	  · exact Opens.cechPicMap_ι_eq_one_of_cechPicClass_eq_one (hW.basicOpen f)
56	      (Opens.cechPicClass_basicOpen_eq_one_of_free hW L f hfree)

375	theorem DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq [IsProper C.hom] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R)
376	    (S : ι → Type u)
377	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
378	    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
379	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) {F G : DivFamZarAff C R n}
380	    (h : ∀ i, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F = DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n G) :

387	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback

390	    (fun i => d₁.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i) n)

395	/-! ## Obligation I-0492 4(i) read on the FIBRE CURVE
396	
397	The widened assembler's fibrewise-regularity input (`hfib` of
398	`AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy`, `DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) is stated as a
399	tensor condition: `eqn j ⊗ 1` is a nonzerodivisor in `Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p)`.  Protection
400	I-0492 clause 4(i) says that datum must come from the seed's own degree data, and a tensor
401	product is not the shape any geometric argument produces.
402	
403	The section base change of this file's upstream turns it into the shape that IS produced:
404	`Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p) ≅ Γ(relCurve C κ(p), relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ pieces j)`, so `hfib` at `p` says
405	exactly that the **pulled equation is regular on the fibre curve over `κ(p)`** — a statement
406	about a section of a sheaf on a curve over a field, checkable germ by germ.
407	
408	This is a restatement, not a discharge: the obligation stays an obligation, as clause 4(i)
409	requires.  What changes is that it is now stated in the vocabulary the seed layer speaks.  -/
