415	/-- **The fibrewise-regularity obligation, read on the fibre curve.**  `eqn j ⊗ 1` is a
416	nonzerodivisor in `Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p)` **iff** the compared equation is a nonzerodivisor in
417	the sections of the fibre curve over `κ(p)` on the preimage of the piece.
418	
419	Both directions are the same ring isomorphism, so this is an honest translation with no
420	hypothesis beyond affineness of the piece — which is a field of `AffCoverData`. -/
421	theorem AffAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff {D : AffCoverData C R}
422	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (A : AffAdaptation D d) (j : D.index)
423	    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
424	    (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
425	        Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
426	      nonZeroDivisors (Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
427	    ↔ relAffSectionsMap C p.asIdeal.ResidueField (D.pieces j) (A.eqn j) ∈
428	        nonZeroDivisors
429	          Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
430	            relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j) := by
431	  let e : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃+*
432	      Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
433	        relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j) :=
434	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
435	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField).toRingEquiv.trans
436	      (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C p.asIdeal.ResidueField (D.isAffineOpen j)).toRingEquiv
437	  have hval : e (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
438	      = relAffSectionsMap C p.asIdeal.ResidueField (D.pieces j) (A.eqn j) := by
439	    change (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C p.asIdeal.ResidueField (D.isAffineOpen j))
440	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
441	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) = _
442	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
443	      relSectionsBaseChangeAff_one_tmul C p.asIdeal.ResidueField (D.isAffineOpen j)]
444	  refine ⟨fun h => hval ▸ map_mem_nonZeroDivisors' e h, fun h => ?_⟩
445	  have hback := map_mem_nonZeroDivisors' e.symm (hval ▸ h)
446	  rwa [e.symm_apply_apply] at hback
447

148	    [Module.Finite B Q] [Module.Projective B Q]
149	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B, Module.rankAtStalk Q p = 1)

155	  classical
156	  let f : PrimeSpectrum B → B := fun p ↦
157	    (exists_notMem_bijective_toSpanSingleton p (hrank p) q (hq p)).choose
158	  have hf (p : PrimeSpectrum B) : f p ∉ p.asIdeal :=
159	    (exists_notMem_bijective_toSpanSingleton p (hrank p) q (hq p)).choose_spec.1
160	  have hbij (p : PrimeSpectrum B) : Function.Bijective
161	      (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers (f p))

163	    (exists_notMem_bijective_toSpanSingleton p (hrank p) q (hq p)).choose_spec.2

165	    by_contra hne

167	    let p : PrimeSpectrum B := ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩
168	    exact hf p (hle (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self p)))
169	  refine bijective_of_localized_span (Set.range f) hspan

180	    (q q' : Q)

182	      (q ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
183	        Q ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
184	    (hq' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
185	      (q' ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
186	        Q ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
187	    ∃! u : Bˣ, q' = (u : B) • q := by

11	/-!
12	# Descent-backed rank-one certificates for a tied cocycle datum
13	
14	This file is the cohomological half of the native family contract.  A certificate is attached to
15	the displayed `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` and its displayed affine representative; it is never a
16	certificate for a separately chosen module.  The only geometric input is the fibre witness
17	condition (the mapped Čech class has a divisor with vanishing `H¹`), from which the datum
18	dictionary and the rigid engine derive the three cohomological conclusions.
19	
20	The descent stage is essential: arbitrary coefficient rings need not be Noetherian.  We descend
21	the finite cocycle datum to a finitely generated subalgebra, fire the engine there, and transport
22	`H¹`, finite projectivity, and stalk rank through the on-the-nose datum H⁰ base-change
23	equivalence.  Thus the public conclusions are genuinely arbitrary-affine, while the only
24	Noetherian instance is local to the constructed stage.
25	-/

102	  exact D.datumH0BaseChange B' ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)

109	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']

120	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
121	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
122	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
123	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (D.baseChange B') := by

125	  letI : Module.Finite B Q := P.h0_finite
126	  letI : Module.Projective B Q := P.h0_projective
127	  let e : B' ⊗[B] Q ≃ₗ[B']
128	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := P.h0BaseChange B'
129	  letI : Module.Finite B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance

133	    h0_finite := Module.Finite.equiv e
134	    h0_projective := Module.Projective.of_equiv e
135	    h0_rank_one := ?_ }
136	  intro p
137	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
138	  exact P.h0_rank_one (p.comap (algebraMap B B'))

16	/-!
17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
18	
19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
23	
24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
29	
30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
36	-/

59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
60	
61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
69	  represents :
70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
72	  datum_class :

74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
76	  module_iso :
77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)

102	    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U

104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
105	
106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
112	  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
114	
115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶

9	/-!
10	# The m-chart cocycle-glued sheaf (DAT-1, stage 1a)
11	
12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, a family of opens `U : J → X.Opens` and **transition
13	multipliers** `g i j ∈ Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ`, the glued sheaf of `informal/spec-dat-1.md`
14	(the m-chart generalization of the two-chart `AlgebraicGeometry.twistSheaf`), as a sheaf
15	of `k`-modules on the small Zariski site of `X`:
16	`F_g(W) = {s ∈ Π j, Γ(W ⊓ U j) | s i = g i j · s j on W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j for all i, j}`
17	(`AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSheaf`), together with
18	
19	* the **cocycle law** `Scheme.IsGluingCocycle` (`g i i = 1` and
20	  `g i j · g j l = g i l` on triple overlaps) — a `Prop`-structure: the carrier needs no
21	  law (the matching relation is restriction-stable for arbitrary multipliers), the
22	  trivializations consume it;
23	* the **piece trivializations** `F_g(W) ≃ₗ[k] Γ(X, W)` for `W ≤ U j`, given by the
24	  `j`-th component (`AlgebraicGeometry.gluedTriv`), commuting with restriction
25	  (`gluedTriv_res`), with the cross-piece comparison `gluedTriv_eq_unit_mul`
26	  (`triv_i = g i j · triv_j` on opens below both pieces — the m-chart mirror of
27	  `twistTriv₀_inf_eq`).
28	
29	The quasi-coherence packaging on a chart covered by finitely many basic-open pieces
30	(DAT-1 stage 1b) is in `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafQcoh`.
31	
32	## Implementation notes
33	
34	Sections are a genuine `Submodule` of the product of section modules (no defect map: the
35	m-chart defect target would be a product-of-products); every element computation is
36	`Scheme.resHom` bookkeeping, and restriction-path independence is definitional by proof
37	irrelevance of `≤` after `Scheme.resHom_resHom` collapse. The sheaf condition glues each
38	component in the structure sheaf of `k`-modules over the covers `{Wₐ ⊓ U j}ₐ` and checks
39	the matching relation locally, mirroring `isSheaf_twistPresheaf`. The `k`-module
40	structure on section modules is `Scheme.overModule`, activated locally per the house
41	rule; `k` is an explicit argument throughout.
42	-/

52	/-! ## The inclusion lattice of the pieces -/
53	
54	section Incl

56	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens)
57	
58	/-- The double overlap `W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j` is contained in the second piece part `W ⊓ U j`. -/
59	lemma gluedInclSnd (W : X.Opens) (i j : J) : W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j ≤ W ⊓ U j :=
60	  le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right
61	
62	/-- The double overlap `W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j` is contained in the multiplier's home
63	`U i ⊓ U j`. -/
64	lemma gluedInclCoc (W : X.Opens) (i j : J) : W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i ⊓ U j :=
65	  le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right
66	
67	end Incl

69	/-! ## The cocycle law -/
70	
71	/-- **The gluing cocycle law** for a family of transition units
72	`g i j ∈ Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ`: the normalization `g i i = 1` and the cocycle identity
73	`g i j · g j l = g i l` as an equality in the triple-overlap section ring
74	`Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U l)`. A `Prop`-mixin: the glued carrier (`gluedSubmodule`) needs no
75	law; the piece trivializations (`gluedTriv`) consume it. -/
76	structure Scheme.IsGluingCocycle {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens)
77	    (g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ) : Prop where
78	  /-- The diagonal units are `1`. -/
79	  unit_self : ∀ i : J, (g i i : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U i)) = 1
80	  /-- The cocycle identity on the triple overlap `U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U l`. -/
81	  mul_res : ∀ i j l : J,
82	    X.resHom (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U l ≤ U i ⊓ U j) (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
83	        X.resHom (gluedInclCoc U (U i) j l) (g j l : Γ(X, U j ⊓ U l)) =
84	      X.resHom (gluedInclSnd U (U i) j l) (g i l : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U l))
85	
86	/-- The cocycle identity restricted to any open below the triple overlap. -/
87	lemma Scheme.IsGluingCocycle.mul_res_of_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u}
88	    {U : J → X.Opens} {g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ} (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
89	    {i j l : J} {O : X.Opens} (hO : O ≤ U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U l) :
90	    X.resHom (hO.trans (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U l ≤ U i ⊓ U j))
91	          (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
92	        X.resHom (hO.trans (gluedInclCoc U (U i) j l)) (g j l : Γ(X, U j ⊓ U l)) =
93	      X.resHom (hO.trans (gluedInclSnd U (U i) j l)) (g i l : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U l)) := by
94	  have key := congrArg (X.resHom hO) (hc.mul_res i j l)
95	  rw [map_mul] at key
96	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
97	  exact key

101	section GluedSheaf
102	
103	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
104	
105	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
106	
107	/-- Restriction of scheme sections commutes with the `Scheme.overModule` action. -/
108	private lemma resHom_smul' {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (r : k) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
109	    X.resHom h (r • s) = r • X.resHom h s := by
110	  rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
111	  congr 1
112	  exact X.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE h).op r
113	
114	/-- Multiplication by a fixed section commutes with the `Scheme.overModule` action. -/
115	private lemma mul_smul_section {W : X.Opens} (c : Γ(X, W)) (r : k) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
116	    c * (r • s) = r • (c * s) := by
117	  rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, Scheme.overModule_smul_def, mul_left_comm]
118	
119	variable {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens) (g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ)
120	
121	/-- The module of **glued sections** over `W`: families `s` of sections on the pieces
122	`W ⊓ U j` matching through the multipliers `g i j` on every double overlap
123	`W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j`. -/
124	noncomputable def gluedSubmodule (W : X.Opens) :
125	    Submodule k (∀ j : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U j)) where
126	  carrier := {s | ∀ i j : J,
127	    X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j ≤ W ⊓ U i) (s i) =
128	      X.resHom (gluedInclCoc U W i j) (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
129	        X.resHom (gluedInclSnd U W i j) (s j)}
130	  add_mem' {p q} hp hq := fun i j => by
131	    change X.resHom _ (p i + q i) = _ * X.resHom _ (p j + q j)
132	    rw [map_add, map_add, mul_add, hp i j, hq i j]
133	  zero_mem' := fun i j => by
134	    change X.resHom _ (0 : Γ(X, _)) = _ * X.resHom _ (0 : Γ(X, _))
135	    rw [map_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
136	  smul_mem' r p hp := fun i j => by
137	    change X.resHom _ (r • p i) = _ * X.resHom _ (r • p j)
138	    rw [resHom_smul' k, resHom_smul' k, mul_smul_section k, hp i j]
139	
140	lemma mem_gluedSubmodule_iff {W : X.Opens} (s : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U j)) :
141	    s ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g W ↔ ∀ i j : J,
142	      X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j ≤ W ⊓ U i) (s i) =
143	        X.resHom (gluedInclCoc U W i j) (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
144	          X.resHom (gluedInclSnd U W i j) (s j) :=
145	  Iff.rfl
146	
147	/-- The matching relation is stable under componentwise restriction. -/
148	lemma gluedSubmodule_res {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
149	    {s : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U j)} (hs : s ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g W) :
150	    (fun j => X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U j) h) (s j)) ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g W' := by
151	  intro i j
152	  have key := congrArg
153	    (X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U j) (inf_le_inf_right (U i) h) :
154	      W' ⊓ U i ⊓ U j ≤ W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j)) (hs i j)
155	  rw [map_mul] at key
156	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key ⊢
157	  exact key
158	
159	/-- Componentwise restriction of glued sections, as a `k`-linear map. -/
160	noncomputable def gluedRes {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) :
161	    ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) →ₗ[k] ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W') :=
162	  LinearMap.restrict
163	    (LinearMap.pi fun j => (secRes (X.moduleKSheaf k) (inf_le_inf_right (U j) h)).comp
164	      (LinearMap.proj j))
165	    (fun _ hs => gluedSubmodule_res k U g h hs)
166	
167	@[simp]
168	lemma gluedRes_coe {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
169	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) (j : J) :
170	    (gluedRes k U g h s).val j = X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U j) h) (s.val j) :=
171	  rfl

175	/-- The presheaf of glued sections of the multipliers `g` on the pieces `U`. -/
176	noncomputable def gluedPresheaf : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
177	  obj W := ModuleCat.of k ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W.unop)
178	  map {A B} i := ModuleCat.ofHom (gluedRes k U g i.unop.le)
179	  map_id A := by
180	    ext s j
181	    change X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U j) le_rfl) (s.val j) = s.val j
182	    exact Scheme.resHom_self _ _
183	  map_comp {A B D} i j := by
184	    ext s l
185	    change X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U l) (j.unop.le.trans i.unop.le)) (s.val l) =
186	      X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U l) j.unop.le)
187	        (X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U l) i.unop.le) (s.val l))
188	    exact (Scheme.resHom_resHom _ _ _).symm

191	`k`-modules over the covers `{Wₐ ⊓ U j}ₐ`, and the matching relation is local. -/
192	theorem isSheaf_gluedPresheaf :
193	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X : TopCat)) (gluedPresheaf k U g) := by
194	  have h : TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf (C := ModuleCat.{u} k) (X := (X : TopCat))
195	      (gluedPresheaf k U g) := by
196	    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
197	    intro ι W sf hsf
198	    -- the compatibility hypothesis, in `gluedRes` form
199	    have hres : ∀ a b : ι,
200	        gluedRes k U g (inf_le_left : W a ⊓ W b ≤ W a) (sf a) =
201	          gluedRes k U g (inf_le_right : W a ⊓ W b ≤ W b) (sf b) := fun a b => hsf a b
202	    -- glue each component in the structure sheaf of `k`-modules
203	    have hcov : ∀ j : J, (iSup W) ⊓ U j ≤ ⨆ a, W a ⊓ U j := fun j => by
204	      rw [iSup_inf_eq]
205	    have hcompat : ∀ j : J, TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible (X.moduleKSheaf k).obj
206	        (fun a => W a ⊓ U j) (fun a => (sf a).val j) := by
207	      intro j a b
208	      have key := congrArg (fun q : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g (W a ⊓ W b)) =>
209	        X.resHom (le_inf
210	          (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_left))
211	          (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) :
212	            (W a ⊓ U j) ⊓ (W b ⊓ U j) ≤ (W a ⊓ W b) ⊓ U j) (q.val j)) (hres a b)
213	      simp only [gluedRes_coe, Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
214	      exact key
215	    have H : ∀ j : J, ∃! tj : Γ(X, (iSup W) ⊓ U j),
216	        ∀ a : ι, X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (U j) (le_iSup W a)) tj = (sf a).val j := by
217	      intro j
218	      obtain ⟨tj, htj, htju⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
219	        (X := (X : TopCat)) (C := ModuleCat.{u} k) (X.moduleKSheaf k)

223	      exact ⟨tj, fun a => htj a, fun y hy => htju y fun a => hy a⟩
224	    choose t ht htu using H
225	    -- the glued components match through the multipliers: check locally
226	    have hrel : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g (iSup W) := by
227	      intro i j
228	      have hcovΩ : (iSup W) ⊓ U i ⊓ U j ≤ ⨆ a, W a ⊓ U i ⊓ U j := by
229	        rw [iSup_inf_eq, iSup_inf_eq]

231	        (X.moduleKSheaf k) (fun a => W a ⊓ U i ⊓ U j) ((iSup W) ⊓ U i ⊓ U j)

241	        ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W a ⊓ U l))).mp (sf a).property i j

259	/-- **The m-chart glued sheaf** of transition units `g i j ∈ Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ` on the
260	pieces `U : J → X.Opens`: the sheaf of `k`-modules on the small Zariski site of `X`
261	whose sections over `W` are the families `s ∈ Π j, Γ(W ⊓ U j)` with `s i = g i j · s j`
262	on every double overlap. For a cocycle (`Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`) on a covering family
263	this is the line bundle presented by the cocycle, trivialized on each piece
264	(`gluedTriv`). -/
265	noncomputable def gluedSheaf :
266	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X : TopCat)) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
267	  ⟨gluedPresheaf k U g, isSheaf_gluedPresheaf k U g⟩

270	lemma gluedSheaf_obj (W : X.Opens) :
271	    (gluedSheaf k U g).obj.obj (op W) = ModuleCat.of k ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) := rfl

273	lemma secRes_gluedSheaf {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
274	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
275	    secRes (gluedSheaf k U g) h s = gluedRes k U g h s := rfl

279	section Triv

281	variable {U} {g}
282	variable (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
283	
284	/-- **Piece trivialization**: over `W ≤ U j`, the `j`-th component is a `k`-linear
285	equivalence `F_g(W) ≃ₗ[k] Γ(X, W)` (the inverse rebuilds every component through the
286	transition units `g i j`; the cocycle law makes the rebuilt family match). -/
287	noncomputable def gluedTriv (j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ U j) :
288	    ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) ≃ₗ[k] Γ(X, W) where
289	  toFun s := X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW) (s.val j)
290	  map_add' s t := map_add _ _ _
291	  map_smul' r s := resHom_smul' k _ r _
292	  invFun t := ⟨fun i =>
293	    X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW) : W ⊓ U i ≤ U i ⊓ U j)
294	        (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
295	      X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W) t, by
296	    intro i i'
297	    have hO : W ⊓ U i ⊓ U i' ≤ U i ⊓ U i' ⊓ U j :=
298	      le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right)
299	        ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hW)
300	    have hcoc := hc.mul_res_of_le hO
301	    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
302	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
303	    rw [← hcoc, mul_assoc]⟩
304	  left_inv s := by
305	    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i => ?_)
306	    have hloc := (mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (s.val :
307	      ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp s.property i j
308	    have key := congrArg
309	      (X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl (inf_le_left.trans hW) :
310	        W ⊓ U i ≤ W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j)) hloc
311	    rw [map_mul] at key
312	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
313	    rw [Scheme.resHom_self] at key
314	    change X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW))
315	        (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
316	        X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W)
317	          (X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW) (s.val j)) = s.val i
318	    rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, ← key]
319	  right_inv t := by
320	    change X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW)
321	        (X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW) : W ⊓ U j ≤ U j ⊓ U j)
322	            (g j j : Γ(X, U j ⊓ U j)) *
323	          X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ≤ W) t) = t
324	    rw [map_mul, hc.unit_self j, map_one, map_one, one_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom,
325	      Scheme.resHom_self]
326	
327	lemma gluedTriv_apply (j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ U j)
328	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
329	    gluedTriv k hc j hW s = X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW) (s.val j) :=
330	  rfl
331	
332	@[simp]
333	lemma gluedTriv_symm_coe (j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ U j) (t : Γ(X, W)) (i : J) :
334	    ((gluedTriv k hc j hW).symm t).val i =
335	      X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW) : W ⊓ U i ≤ U i ⊓ U j)
336	          (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
337	        X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W) t :=
338	  rfl
339	
340	/-- The piece trivialization commutes with restriction. -/
341	lemma gluedTriv_res (j : J) {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (hW : W ≤ U j)
342	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
343	    gluedTriv k hc j (h.trans hW) (gluedRes k U g h s) =
344	      X.resHom h (gluedTriv k hc j hW s) := by
345	  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
346	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
347	
348	/-- **Cross-piece comparison of the trivializations**: on an open below two pieces the
349	trivializations differ by the transition unit, `triv_i = g i j · triv_j` — the m-chart
350	mirror of `twistTriv₀_inf_eq`. -/
351	lemma gluedTriv_eq_unit_mul (i j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hWi : W ≤ U i) (hWj : W ≤ U j)
352	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
353	    gluedTriv k hc i hWi s =
354	      X.resHom (le_inf hWi hWj : W ≤ U i ⊓ U j) (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
355	        gluedTriv k hc j hWj s := by
356	  have hloc := (mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (s.val :
357	    ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp s.property i j
358	  have key := congrArg
359	    (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf le_rfl hWi) hWj : W ≤ W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j)) hloc
360	  rw [map_mul] at key
361	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
362	  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply]
363	  exact key
364	
365	end Triv
366	
367	end GluedSheaf

369	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	/-!
11	# Cohomologous cocycles glue isomorphic sheaves (DAT-3, the `congrCoeff` transport)
12	
13	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, pieces `U : J → X.Opens` and two multiplier families
14	`g, g'` on the pairwise overlaps, a unit `0`-cochain `c : ∀ j, Γ(X, U j)ˣ` with
15	`c_i · g_{ij} = g'_{ij} · c_j` on every double overlap (the landed `IsCohomologous`
16	convention of the Čech Picard lane, in `resHom` spelling —
17	`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary`) induces an isomorphism of the glued
18	sheaves, componentwise `s_j ↦ c_j · s_j`:
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedCongrEquiv` — the `k`-linear equivalence of glued sections
21	  over every open `W`;
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSheafCongr` — the isomorphism of sheaves of `k`-modules
23	  `gluedSheaf k U g ≅ gluedSheaf k U g'`;
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_congr` — transport of cohomology
25	  vanishing across the isomorphism (via `Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv`).
26	
27	This is the m-chart generalization of the landed two-cover `congrCoeff` pattern
28	(`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule'.congrCoeff`, `Cohomology/RelativeTwoCover.lean`),
29	per the frozen W6-full spec (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §3.1(c)): cohomologous
30	cocycles present isomorphic glued sheaves. Neither multiplier family needs the cocycle
31	law — the transport is pure matching algebra.
32	-/
33	
34	set_option autoImplicit false
35	
36	universe u
37	
38	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
39	
40	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
41	
42	/-- **The gluing coboundary relation**: the multiplier family `g'` is cohomologous to
43	`g` through the unit `0`-cochain `c`, i.e. `c_i · g_{ij} = g'_{ij} · c_j` in
44	`Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)` for all `i, j` (the landed `IsCohomologous` convention of the Čech
45	Picard lane, in `resHom` spelling). -/
46	def Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens)
47	    (g g' : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ) (c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ) : Prop :=
48	  ∀ i j : J,
49	    X.resHom (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i) (c i : Γ(X, U i)) *
50	        (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) =
51	      (g' i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
52	        X.resHom (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j) (c j : Γ(X, U j))
53	
54	namespace Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary
55	
56	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u} {U : J → X.Opens}
57	variable {g g' : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ} {c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ}
58	
59	/-- **Inversion of the coboundary**: if `g'` is cohomologous to `g` through `c`, then
60	`g` is cohomologous to `g'` through the inverse cochain `c⁻¹`. -/
61	lemma inv (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) :
62	    Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g' g (fun j => (c j)⁻¹) := by
63	  intro i j
64	  set a := X.resHom (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i) (c i : Γ(X, U i)) with ha
65	  set a' := X.resHom (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)
66	    (((c i)⁻¹ : Γ(X, U i)ˣ) : Γ(X, U i)) with ha'
67	  set b := X.resHom (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j) (c j : Γ(X, U j)) with hb
68	  set b' := X.resHom (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j)
69	    (((c j)⁻¹ : Γ(X, U j)ˣ) : Γ(X, U j)) with hb'
70	  have haa : a' * a = 1 := by rw [ha, ha', ← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one]
71	  have hbb : b * b' = 1 := by rw [hb, hb', ← map_mul, Units.mul_inv, map_one]
72	  have key : a * (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) = (g' i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) * b := hc i j
73	  calc a' * (g' i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j))
74	      = a' * (g' i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) * (b * b') := by rw [hbb, mul_one]
75	    _ = a' * ((g' i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) * b) * b' := by ring
76	    _ = a' * (a * (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j))) * b' := by rw [key]
77	    _ = (a' * a) * (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) * b' := by ring
78	    _ = (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) * b' := by rw [haa, one_mul]
79	
80	end Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary

82	section Congr
83	
84	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
85	
86	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
87	
88	variable {J : Type u} {U : J → X.Opens} {g g' : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ}
89	variable (c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ)
90	
91	/-- **The coboundary transport preserves matching**: multiplying the `j`-th component by
92	(the restriction of) `c j` carries families matching through `g` to families matching
93	through `g'`. -/
94	lemma gluedCongr_mem (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) {W : X.Opens}
95	    {s : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U j)} (hs : s ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g W) :
96	    (fun j => X.resHom (inf_le_right : W ⊓ U j ≤ U j) (c j : Γ(X, U j)) * s j)
97	      ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g' W := by
98	  intro i j
99	  have hcob := congrArg (X.resHom (gluedInclCoc U W i j)) (hc i j)
100	  have hmatch := (mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g s).mp hs i j
101	  rw [map_mul, map_mul] at hcob
102	  rw [map_mul, map_mul]
103	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hcob hmatch ⊢
104	  rw [hmatch, ← mul_assoc, hcob, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
105	
106	variable (g g') in
107	/-- **The coboundary transport of glued sections**, as a `k`-linear equivalence:
108	componentwise multiplication by the unit `0`-cochain `c` (inverse: componentwise
109	multiplication by `c⁻¹`). -/
110	noncomputable def gluedCongrEquiv (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c)
111	    (W : X.Opens) :
112	    ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) ≃ₗ[k] ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g' W) where
113	  toFun s := ⟨fun j => X.resHom (inf_le_right : W ⊓ U j ≤ U j) (c j : Γ(X, U j)) *
114	    s.val j, gluedCongr_mem k c hc s.property⟩
115	  map_add' s t := Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
116	    change X.resHom _ (c j : Γ(X, U j)) * (s.val j + t.val j) = _
117	    rw [mul_add]
118	    rfl)
119	  map_smul' r s := Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
120	    change X.resHom _ (c j : Γ(X, U j)) * (r • s.val j) = _
121	    rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, mul_left_comm]
122	    rfl)
123	  invFun t := ⟨fun j => X.resHom (inf_le_right : W ⊓ U j ≤ U j)
124	    (((c j)⁻¹ : Γ(X, U j)ˣ) : Γ(X, U j)) * t.val j,
125	    gluedCongr_mem k (fun j => (c j)⁻¹) hc.inv t.property⟩
126	  left_inv s := Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
127	    change X.resHom _ (((c j)⁻¹ : Γ(X, U j)ˣ) : Γ(X, U j)) *
128	      (X.resHom _ (c j : Γ(X, U j)) * s.val j) = s.val j
129	    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one, one_mul])
130	  right_inv t := Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
131	    change X.resHom _ (c j : Γ(X, U j)) *
132	      (X.resHom _ (((c j)⁻¹ : Γ(X, U j)ˣ) : Γ(X, U j)) * t.val j) = t.val j
133	    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Units.mul_inv, map_one, one_mul])
134	
135	@[simp]
136	lemma gluedCongrEquiv_apply_coe (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c)
137	    {W : X.Opens} (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) (j : J) :
138	    (gluedCongrEquiv k g g' c hc W s).val j =
139	      X.resHom (inf_le_right : W ⊓ U j ≤ U j) (c j : Γ(X, U j)) * s.val j :=
140	  rfl
141	
142	/-- The coboundary transport commutes with restriction. -/
143	lemma gluedCongrEquiv_res (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c)
144	    {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
145	    gluedCongrEquiv k g g' c hc W' (gluedRes k U g h s) =
146	      gluedRes k U g' h (gluedCongrEquiv k g g' c hc W s) := by
147	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
148	  rw [gluedCongrEquiv_apply_coe, gluedRes_coe, gluedRes_coe, gluedCongrEquiv_apply_coe,
149	    map_mul]
150	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
151	
152	variable (g g') in
153	/-- **The presheaf isomorphism of cohomologous glued presheaves**, componentwise
154	multiplication by the unit `0`-cochain. -/
155	noncomputable def gluedCongrPresheafIso (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) :
156	    gluedPresheaf k U g ≅ gluedPresheaf k U g' :=
157	  NatIso.ofComponents
158	    (fun W => (gluedCongrEquiv k g g' c hc W.unop).toModuleIso)
159	    (fun {A B} i => by
160	      ext s
161	      exact gluedCongrEquiv_res k c hc i.unop.le s)
162	
163	variable (g g') in
164	/-- **Cohomologous cocycles glue isomorphic sheaves** (the m-chart `congrCoeff`
165	transport, W6-full spec §3.1(c)): a unit `0`-cochain `c` with `c_i g_{ij} = g'_{ij} c_j`
166	induces an isomorphism `gluedSheaf k U g ≅ gluedSheaf k U g'` of sheaves of
167	`k`-modules, componentwise `s_j ↦ c_j · s_j`. -/
168	noncomputable def gluedSheafCongr (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) :
169	    gluedSheaf k U g ≅ gluedSheaf k U g' :=
170	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso (gluedCongrPresheafIso k g g' c hc)
171	
172	/-- **Cohomology vanishing transports across the coboundary**: the glued sheaves of
173	cohomologous multiplier families have simultaneously vanishing cohomology in every
174	degree. -/
175	theorem subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_congr (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c)
176	    (n : ℕ) :
177	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (gluedSheaf k U g) n) ↔
178	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (gluedSheaf k U g') n) :=
179	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (gluedSheafCongr k g g' c hc) n).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr
180	
181	end Congr
182	
183	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafClass
7	
8	/-!
9	# Subordination invariance of the glued sheaf (the W6-full fibre-restriction bridge)
10	
11	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, pieces `U : J → X.Opens` carrying a gluing cocycle `g`,
12	and a second covering family `V : I → X.Opens` subordinated to the pieces along
13	`σ : I → J` (`V i ≤ U (σ i)`), the glued sheaf of the restricted transition units on
14	`V` is isomorphic to the glued sheaf of `g` on `U`:
15	
16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordFwd` — componentwise restriction of glued sections
17	  `F_g(W) → F_{g'}(W)`, `s ↦ (res s_{σ i})_i`;
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordSection` — the inverse assembly: the `j`-th component
19	  of a `V`-glued family `t` glues from the candidates `g j (σ i) · t_i` over the cover
20	  `{W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i}_i` (the cocycle law makes them compatible);
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordEquiv` — the `k`-linear equivalence of glued sections,
22	  natural in `W` (`gluedSubordEquiv_res`);
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSheafSubord` — **the sheaf isomorphism**
24	  `gluedSheaf k U g ≅ gluedSheaf k V g'`;
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_subord` — cohomology-vanishing
26	  transport across the isomorphism.
27	
28	The target multipliers `g'` are abstract — the hypothesis `hg'` pins their underlying
29	sections to the restricted transition units `g (σ i) (σ i')` — so the isomorphism
30	instantiates on the nose at the subordinated unit cocycle of a pinned basic-open
31	cocycle datum (`gluedSubordUnit`, `gluedSubordCocycle_evInf`): the datum's glued sheaf
32	against the glued sheaf of the meromorphic presentation
33	`MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle` of its Čech Picard class. That instantiation — the
34	step-(c) bridge of the W6-full fibre-restriction seam — is in
35	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafDatumFibre`.
36	-/
37	
38	set_option autoImplicit false
39	
40	universe u
41	
42	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
43	
44	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
45	
46	section Subord
47	
48	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
49	
50	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
51	
52	variable {J I : Type u} {U : J → X.Opens} {g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ}
53	variable {V : I → X.Opens} {g' : ∀ i i' : I, Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')ˣ} {σ : I → J}
54	
55	/-! ## The forward map: componentwise restriction -/
56	
57	/-- **Componentwise restriction preserves matching**: restricting the `σ i`-th
58	component of a `U`-glued family to `W ⊓ V i` yields a `V`-glued family for the
59	restricted multipliers. -/
60	lemma gluedSubordFwd_mem (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
61	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
62	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
63	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
64	    {W : X.Opens} {s : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U j)} (hs : s ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g W) :
65	    (fun i => X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i)) (s (σ i)))
66	      ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W := by
67	  intro i i'
68	  have key := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
69	      ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hσ i)))
70	      (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')) :
71	      W ⊓ V i ⊓ V i' ≤ W ⊓ U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) (hs (σ i) (σ i'))
72	  rw [map_mul] at key
73	  rw [hg' i i']
74	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key ⊢
75	  exact key
76	
77	/-- **The forward map of the subordination**: componentwise restriction of glued
78	sections along `W ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U (σ i)`, as a `k`-linear map. -/
79	noncomputable def gluedSubordFwd (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
80	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
81	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
82	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
83	    (W : X.Opens) :
84	    ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) →ₗ[k] ↥(gluedSubmodule k V g' W) where
85	  toFun s := ⟨fun i =>
86	      secRes (X.moduleKSheaf k) (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i)) (s.val (σ i)),
87	    gluedSubordFwd_mem k hσ hg' s.property⟩
88	  map_add' s t := Subtype.ext (funext fun i =>
89	    map_add (secRes (X.moduleKSheaf k) (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i)))
90	      (s.val (σ i)) (t.val (σ i)))
91	  map_smul' r s := Subtype.ext (funext fun i =>
92	    map_smul (secRes (X.moduleKSheaf k) (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i))) r
93	      (s.val (σ i)))
94	
95	@[simp]
96	lemma gluedSubordFwd_coe (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
97	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
98	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
99	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
100	    {W : X.Opens} (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) (i : I) :
101	    (gluedSubordFwd k hσ hg' W s).val i
102	      = X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i)) (s.val (σ i)) :=
103	  rfl
104	
105	/-! ## The inverse assembly -/
106	
107	variable (g) in
108	/-- The `(j, i)`-th candidate of the inverse assembly: over `W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i`, the
109	`j`-th component of the assembled `U`-glued family is `g j (σ i) · t i`. -/
110	noncomputable def gluedSubordCand (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i)) {W : X.Opens}
111	    (t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)) (j : J) (i : I) : Γ(X, W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i) :=
112	  X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i)) :
113	      W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i ≤ U j ⊓ U (σ i)) (g j (σ i) : Γ(X, U j ⊓ U (σ i)))
114	    * X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
115	        W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ V i) (t i)
116	
117	/-- **The candidates are compatible** (the cocycle law at `(j, σ i, σ i')` against the
118	matching of `t`): the candidates `g j (σ i) · t i` agree on the pairwise overlaps of
119	the cover `{W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i}_i`. -/
120	lemma gluedSubordCand_compatible (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
121	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
122	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
123	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
124	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
125	    {W : X.Opens} {t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)}
126	    (ht : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W) (j : J) (i i' : I) :
127	    X.resHom (inf_le_left : (W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i) ⊓ (W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i') ≤ W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i)
128	        (gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i)
129	      = X.resHom inf_le_right (gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i') := by
130	  -- the matching of `t`, restricted to the overlap and rewritten through `hg'`
131	  have hmatch := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf
132	      (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)) (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
133	      (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right) :
134	      (W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i) ⊓ (W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i') ≤ W ⊓ V i ⊓ V i')) (ht i i')
135	  rw [map_mul, hg' i i'] at hmatch
136	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hmatch
137	  -- the cocycle law at `(j, σ i, σ i')`, restricted to the overlap
138	  have hcoc := hc.mul_res_of_le (le_inf (le_inf
139	      (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
140	      ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hσ i)))
141	      ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hσ i')) :
142	      (W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i) ⊓ (W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i') ≤ U j ⊓ U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))
143	  rw [gluedSubordCand, gluedSubordCand, map_mul, map_mul]
144	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
145	  rw [hmatch, ← mul_assoc, hcoc]
146	
147	/-- **Existence and uniqueness of the assembled component**: the candidates
148	`g j (σ i) · t i` glue to a unique section over `W ⊓ U j` (the family `V` covers). -/
149	lemma gluedSubordSection_existsUnique (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
150	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
151	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
152	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
153	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
154	    {W : X.Opens} {t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)}
155	    (ht : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W) (j : J) :
156	    ∃! sj : Γ(X, W ⊓ U j), ∀ i : I,
157	      X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U j) sj
158	        = gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i := by
159	  have hcover : W ⊓ U j ≤ ⨆ i : I, W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i := fun z hz => by
160	    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov z
161	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, hz, hi⟩
162	  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible (X.moduleKSheaf k).obj
163	      (fun i : I => W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i) (fun i => gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i) := by
164	    intro i i'
165	    exact gluedSubordCand_compatible k hσ hg' hc ht j i i'
166	  obtain ⟨sj, hsj, hsju⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
167	    (X := (X : TopCat)) (C := ModuleCat.{u} k) (X.moduleKSheaf k)
168	    (fun i : I => W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i) (W ⊓ U j)
169	    (fun i => homOfLE inf_le_left) hcover
170	    (fun i => gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i) hcompat
171	  exact ⟨sj, fun i => hsj i, fun y hy => hsju y fun i => hy i⟩
172	
173	/-- The assembled `j`-th component of the inverse of the subordination map. -/
174	noncomputable def gluedSubordSection (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
175	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
176	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
177	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
178	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
179	    {W : X.Opens} {t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)}
180	    (ht : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W) (j : J) : Γ(X, W ⊓ U j) :=
181	  (gluedSubordSection_existsUnique k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j).exists.choose
182	
183	/-- The defining property of the assembled component. -/
184	lemma gluedSubordSection_res (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
185	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
186	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
187	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
188	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
189	    {W : X.Opens} {t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)}
190	    (ht : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W) (j : J) (i : I) :
191	    X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U j)
192	        (gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j)
193	      = gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i :=
194	  (gluedSubordSection_existsUnique k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j).exists.choose_spec i
195	
196	/-- Uniqueness of the assembled component. -/
197	lemma gluedSubordSection_unique (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
198	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
199	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
200	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
201	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
202	    {W : X.Opens} {t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)}
203	    (ht : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W) (j : J) {sj : Γ(X, W ⊓ U j)}
204	    (hsj : ∀ i : I, X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U j) sj
205	      = gluedSubordCand g hσ t j i) :
206	    sj = gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j :=
207	  (gluedSubordSection_existsUnique k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j).unique hsj
208	    (gluedSubordSection_res k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j)
209	
210	include k in
211	/-- Separation over the subordinated cover: two sections of an open agreeing on every
212	`· ⊓ V i` agree. -/
213	private lemma sectionExt (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i) {O : X.Opens}
214	    {s s' : Γ(X, O)}
215	    (h : ∀ i : I, X.resHom (inf_le_left : O ⊓ V i ≤ O) s
216	      = X.resHom inf_le_left s') : s = s' := by
217	  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (X := (X : TopCat)) (C := ModuleCat.{u} k)
218	    (X.moduleKSheaf k) (fun i : I => O ⊓ V i) O (fun i => homOfLE inf_le_left)
219	    (fun z hz => by
220	      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov z
221	      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, hz, hi⟩)
222	  exact h
223	
224	/-- **The assembled components match through `g`**: the inverse assembly is a
225	`U`-glued family (checked on the subordinated cover through the cocycle law at
226	`(j, j', σ i)`). -/
227	lemma gluedSubordSection_mem (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
228	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
229	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
230	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
231	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
232	    {W : X.Opens} {t : ∀ i : I, Γ(X, W ⊓ V i)}
233	    (ht : t ∈ gluedSubmodule k V g' W) :
234	    (fun j => gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j)
235	      ∈ gluedSubmodule k U g W := by
236	  intro j j'
237	  refine sectionExt k hcov (fun i => ?_)
238	  -- the left side restricts to the `(j, i)`-th candidate
239	  have hL := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
240	      W ⊓ U j ⊓ U j' ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i))
241	    (gluedSubordSection_res k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j i)
242	  -- the right side restricts to the `(j', i)`-th candidate
243	  have hR := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf
244	      (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left))
245	      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)) inf_le_right :
246	      W ⊓ U j ⊓ U j' ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U j' ⊓ V i))
247	    (gluedSubordSection_res k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j' i)
248	  rw [gluedSubordCand, map_mul] at hL hR
249	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hL hR
250	  -- the cocycle law at `(j, j', σ i)`
251	  have hcoc := hc.mul_res_of_le (le_inf (le_inf
252	      (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)) (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
253	      (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i)) :
254	      W ⊓ U j ⊓ U j' ⊓ V i ≤ U j ⊓ U j' ⊓ U (σ i))
255	  change X.resHom _ (X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ⊓ U j' ≤ W ⊓ U j)
256	      (gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j))
257	    = X.resHom _ (X.resHom (gluedInclCoc U W j j') (g j j' : Γ(X, U j ⊓ U j'))
258	        * X.resHom (gluedInclSnd U W j j') (gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov ht j'))
259	  rw [map_mul]
260	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
261	  rw [hL, hR, ← mul_assoc, hcoc]
262	
263	/-! ## The equivalence -/
264	
265	/-- **Left inverse**: the assembly of the componentwise restriction of a `U`-glued
266	family recovers its components (by the uniqueness of the gluing — `s j` restricts to
267	every candidate of its own image, through the matching of `s` at `(j, σ i)`). -/
268	lemma gluedSubordSection_fwd (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
269	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
270	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
271	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
272	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
273	    {W : X.Opens} (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) (j : J) :
274	    gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov
275	        (gluedSubordFwd_mem k hσ hg' s.property) j = s.val j := by
276	  refine (gluedSubordSection_unique k hσ hg' hc hcov
277	    (gluedSubordFwd_mem k hσ hg' s.property) j (fun i => ?_)).symm
278	  have key := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf
279	      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
280	      (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i)) :
281	      W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i ≤ W ⊓ U j ⊓ U (σ i))) (s.property j (σ i))
282	  rw [map_mul] at key
283	  rw [gluedSubordCand]
284	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key ⊢
285	  exact key
286	
287	/-- **Right inverse**: the componentwise restriction of the assembly recovers the
288	`V`-glued family (by separation — over `W ⊓ V i ⊓ V i'` both sides are
289	`g (σ i) (σ i') · t i'`, through the defining property of the assembly and the
290	matching of `t`). -/
291	lemma gluedSubordFwd_section (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
292	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
293	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
294	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
295	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
296	    {W : X.Opens} (t : ↥(gluedSubmodule k V g' W)) (i : I) :
297	    X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i))
298	        (gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov t.property (σ i)) = t.val i := by
299	  refine sectionExt k hcov (fun i' => ?_)
300	  -- the restriction of the assembly is `g (σ i) (σ i') · t i'`
301	  have hL := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf
302	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
303	        ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hσ i))) inf_le_right :
304	      W ⊓ V i ⊓ V i' ≤ W ⊓ U (σ i) ⊓ V i'))
305	    (gluedSubordSection_res k hσ hg' hc hcov t.property (σ i) i')
306	  rw [gluedSubordCand, map_mul] at hL
307	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hL
308	  -- the matching of `t` gives the same value
309	  have hmatch := t.property i i'
310	  rw [hg' i i'] at hmatch
311	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hmatch
312	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
313	  rw [hL, hmatch]
314	
315	/-- **The subordination equivalence of glued sections**: componentwise restriction
316	along `σ`, with inverse the candidate assembly. -/
317	noncomputable def gluedSubordEquiv (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
318	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
319	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
320	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
321	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
322	    (W : X.Opens) :
323	    ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) ≃ₗ[k] ↥(gluedSubmodule k V g' W) :=
324	  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (gluedSubordFwd k hσ hg' W)
325	    (Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
326	      ⟨fun t => ⟨fun j => gluedSubordSection k hσ hg' hc hcov t.property j,
327	          gluedSubordSection_mem k hσ hg' hc hcov t.property⟩,
328	        fun s => Subtype.ext (funext fun j =>
329	          gluedSubordSection_fwd k hσ hg' hc hcov s j),
330	        fun t => Subtype.ext (funext fun i =>
331	          gluedSubordFwd_section k hσ hg' hc hcov t i)⟩)
332	
333	@[simp]
334	lemma gluedSubordEquiv_apply_coe (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
335	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
336	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
337	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
338	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
339	    {W : X.Opens} (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) (i : I) :
340	    (gluedSubordEquiv k hσ hg' hc hcov W s).val i
341	      = X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left W (hσ i)) (s.val (σ i)) :=
342	  rfl
343	
344	/-- The subordination equivalence commutes with restriction (the forward map is
345	componentwise restriction). -/
346	lemma gluedSubordEquiv_res (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
347	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
348	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
349	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
350	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i)
351	    {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
352	    gluedSubordEquiv k hσ hg' hc hcov W' (gluedRes k U g h s)
353	      = gluedRes k V g' h (gluedSubordEquiv k hσ hg' hc hcov W s) := by
354	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i => ?_)
355	  rw [gluedSubordEquiv_apply_coe, gluedRes_coe, gluedRes_coe,
356	    gluedSubordEquiv_apply_coe]
357	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
358	
359	/-- **The subordination isomorphism of glued presheaves.** -/
360	noncomputable def gluedSubordPresheafIso (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
361	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
362	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
363	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
364	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i) :
365	    gluedPresheaf k U g ≅ gluedPresheaf k V g' :=
366	  NatIso.ofComponents
367	    (fun W => (gluedSubordEquiv k hσ hg' hc hcov W.unop).toModuleIso)
368	    (fun {A B} i => by
369	      ext s
370	      exact gluedSubordEquiv_res k hσ hg' hc hcov i.unop.le s)
371	
372	/-- **Subordination invariance of the glued sheaf**: a covering family subordinated to
373	the pieces of a gluing cocycle glues an isomorphic sheaf through the restricted
374	transition units. -/
375	noncomputable def gluedSheafSubord (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
376	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
377	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
378	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
379	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i) :
380	    gluedSheaf k U g ≅ gluedSheaf k V g' :=
381	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
382	    (gluedSubordPresheafIso k hσ hg' hc hcov)
383	
384	/-- **Cohomology vanishing transports across the subordination** in every degree. -/
385	theorem subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_subord (hσ : ∀ i : I, V i ≤ U (σ i))
386	    (hg' : ∀ i i' : I, (g' i i' : Γ(X, V i ⊓ V i')) =
387	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ i)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ i')))
388	        (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))))
389	    (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (hcov : ∀ z : X, ∃ i : I, z ∈ V i) (n : ℕ) :
390	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (gluedSheaf k U g) n) ↔
391	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (gluedSheaf k V g') n) :=
392	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (gluedSheafSubord k hσ hg' hc hcov)
393	    n).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr

6	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.NonabelianCohomology.H1
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CechH1
8	
9	/-!
10	# Unit-valued Čech cocycles on pointed covers and their pullback
11	
12	This file sets up the cocycle-level substrate of the Čech Picard group
13	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic`):
14	
15	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PointedCover`: one open per point, containing it; a
16	  `SemilatticeInf` with an `OrderTop`, refinement `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x`,
17	  and pullback along a morphism of schemes.
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsCocycle`, `Scheme.unitsH1`: unit-valued Čech 1-cocycles
19	  and `H¹` on a pointed cover; `Scheme.unitsRes`: restriction along a refinement, a group
20	  homomorphism, strictly functorial (`unitsRes_unitsRes`).
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsEvInf`, `Scheme.unitsRestrict`: the pair values of a
22	  unit cocycle and restriction of unit sections, retyped through `Γ(X, U)ˣ`. Statements
23	  phrased through these are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising
24	  from the `OneCochain` field types (whose carriers go through `unitsPresheaf.obj`) are
25	  closed against them by `exact` — the two spellings are definitionally equal.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle`, `Hom.pullbackUnitsH1`: pullback of
27	  unit cocycles and their `H¹` classes along a morphism of schemes, compatible with
28	  restriction (`unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1`) — the substrate for `CechPic.map`.
29	
30	The file starts with generic `evInf` algebra for `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups`
31	(values of cochains/cocycles at binary infima commute with `1`, `*`, `⁻¹`); it lives here
32	only because `CechH1.lean` is at the file-size cap, and should move alongside
33	`OneCochain.evInf` when that file is split for a mathlib PR.
34	-/
35	
36	set_option autoImplicit false
37	
38	universe w' w u
39	
40	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
41

88	/-! ## Pointed covers -/
89	
90	/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. Pointed covers
91	are the index discipline of `Scheme.CechPic`: the index type is the carrier of `X` (so
92	everything stays in `Type u`), refinement is indexwise, and pointwise `⊓` makes the
93	refinement order directed. -/
94	structure PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
95	  /-- The member of the cover attached to a point. -/
96	  opens : X → X.Opens
97	  /-- Each point lies in its member. -/
98	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
99	
100	namespace PointedCover
101	
102	@[ext]
103	lemma ext {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : ∀ x, 𝒰.opens x = 𝒱.opens x) : 𝒰 = 𝒱 := by
104	  cases 𝒰; cases 𝒱
105	  simpa using funext h
106	
107	instance : SemilatticeInf X.PointedCover where
108	  le 𝒱 𝒰 := ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x
109	  le_refl 𝒰 x := le_rfl
110	  le_trans 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := (h₁ x).trans (h₂ x)
111	  le_antisymm 𝒰 𝒱 h₁ h₂ := ext fun x ↦ le_antisymm (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
112	  inf 𝒰 𝒱 :=
113	    { opens := fun x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x
114	      mem_opens := fun x ↦ ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, 𝒱.mem_opens x⟩ }
115	  inf_le_left 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_left
116	  inf_le_right 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_right
117	  le_inf 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := le_inf (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
118	
119	instance : OrderTop X.PointedCover where
120	  top := { opens := fun _ ↦ ⊤, mem_opens := fun _ ↦ trivial }
121	  le_top _ _ := le_top
122	
123	lemma le_def {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x :=
124	  Iff.rfl
125	
126	@[simp]
127	lemma inf_opens (𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover) (x : X) :
128	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x = 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x :=
129	  rfl
130	
131	@[simp]
132	lemma top_opens (x : X) : (⊤ : X.PointedCover).opens x = ⊤ :=
133	  rfl
134	
135	/-- The pullback of a pointed cover along a morphism of schemes: the pointed cover by
136	preimages, `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`. -/
137	def pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) : X.PointedCover where
138	  opens x := f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x)
139	  mem_opens x := 𝒰.mem_opens (f.base x)
140	
141	@[simp]
142	lemma pullback_opens (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (x : X) :
143	    (𝒰.pullback f).opens x = f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x) :=
144	  rfl
145	
146	lemma pullback_mono (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 𝒱 : Y.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) :
147	    𝒱.pullback f ≤ 𝒰.pullback f :=
148	  fun x ↦ ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE (h (f.base x)))).le
149

152	/-! ## Unit cocycles on a pointed cover and their restriction -/
153	
154	/-- The unit-valued Čech 1-cocycles of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
155	abbrev unitsCocycle (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
156	  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
157	
158	/-- The unit-valued Čech `H¹` of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
159	abbrev unitsH1 (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
160	  PresheafOfGroups.H1 (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
161	
162	/-- Restriction of unit Čech classes along a refinement of pointed covers, as a group
163	homomorphism. -/
164	def unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) : X.unitsH1 𝒰 →* X.unitsH1 𝒱 :=
165	  H1.resHom fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)
166	
167	/-- Restriction along refinements of pointed covers is strictly functorial. -/
168	@[simp]
169	lemma unitsRes_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 : X.PointedCover} (h₁ : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱)
170	    (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : unitsRes h₂ (unitsRes h₁ a) = unitsRes (h₂.trans h₁) a :=
171	  H1.res_res _ _ a
172	
173	@[simp]
174	lemma unitsRes_rfl {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} {h : 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
175	    unitsRes h a = a :=
176	  H1.res_id a
177	/-- If `U` is contained in the preimages of two opens, it is contained in the preimage
178	of their intersection. -/
179	lemma Hom.le_preimage_inf (f : X.Hom Y) {U : X.Opens} {V₁ V₂ : Y.Opens}
180	    (h₁ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₁) (h₂ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₂) : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V₁ ⊓ V₂) :=
181	  fun _ hx ↦ ⟨h₁ hx, h₂ hx⟩
182	
183	/-- The pair value `γ.evInf i j` of a unit Čech cocycle, retyped as a unit section in
184	`Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ` (definitionally equal). Statements phrased through
185	`unitsEvInf` are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising from the
186	`OneCochain` field types are closed against them by `exact` (definitional bridging). -/
187	def unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
188	    Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ :=
189	  γ.evInf i j
190	
191	/-- Restriction of a unit section along `W ≤ U`, as a group homomorphism between the
192	honest `Γ`-typed unit groups (definitionally the units-presheaf restriction map). -/
193	abbrev unitsRestrict (X : Scheme.{u}) {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) :
194	    Γ(X, U)ˣ →* Γ(X, W)ˣ :=
195	  Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
196	
197	@[simp]
198	lemma one_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (i j : X) :
199	    unitsEvInf (1 : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) i j = 1 :=
200	  rfl
201	
202	@[simp]
203	lemma mul_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ₁ γ₂ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
204	    unitsEvInf (γ₁ * γ₂) i j = unitsEvInf γ₁ i j * unitsEvInf γ₂ i j :=
205	  rfl
206	
207	/-- The cocycle identity for the pair values, in unit-section language. -/
208	lemma unitsEvInf_trans {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : X) :
209	    X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
210	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)
211	        (unitsEvInf γ i j)
212	      * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right :
213	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
214	          (unitsEvInf γ j k)
215	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
216	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
217	          (unitsEvInf γ i k) :=
218	  γ.evInf_trans i j k
219	
220	/-- Restriction along a refinement, at the level of pair values. -/
221	lemma res_unitsEvInf {𝒲 𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (hle : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰)
222	    (i j : X) :
223	    unitsEvInf (γ.res fun k ↦ homOfLE (hle k)) i j
224	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hle i) (hle j)) (unitsEvInf γ i j) :=
225	  γ.res_evInf _ i j

230	/-- Pullback of the cocycle identity: the pair values of a unit cocycle on `Y`, pulled
231	back through `f : X ⟶ Y` to a common open `T`, still satisfy the cocycle identity. -/
232	private lemma pullback_pair_trans (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 : Y.PointedCover}
233	    (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : Y) {T : X.Opens}
234	    (e₁ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)) (e₂ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k))
235	    (e₃ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)) :
236	    f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j) T e₁ (unitsEvInf γ i j)
237	      * f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T e₂ (unitsEvInf γ j k)
238	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T e₃ (unitsEvInf γ i k) := by
239	  have E : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) :=
240	    fun t ht ↦ ⟨e₁ ht, (e₂ ht).2⟩
241	  have ht := congrArg (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T E)
242	    (unitsEvInf_trans γ i j k)
243	  rw [map_mul, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE,
244	    Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at ht
245	  exact ht

247	/-- The pullback of a unit 1-cocycle along a morphism of schemes, on the pulled-back
248	pointed cover. -/
249	def pullbackUnitsCocycle (f : X ⟶ Y) (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
250	    X.unitsCocycle (𝒰.pullback f) where
251	  ev x y _ a b :=
252	    f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) _
253	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
254	  ev_precomp x y _ _ φ a b :=
255	    f.unitsAppLE_map (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) φ.op
256	      (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
257	  ev_trans x y z _ a b c :=
258	    pullback_pair_trans f γ (f.base x) (f.base y) (f.base z)
259	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (f.le_preimage_inf b.le c.le)
260	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le c.le)
261	
262	@[simp]
263	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x y : X) {T : X.Opens}
264	    (a : T ⟶ (𝒰.pullback f).opens x) (b : T ⟶ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y) :
265	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).ev x y a b
266	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
267	          (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y)) :=
268	  rfl
269	
270	@[simp]
271	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x y : X) :
272	    unitsEvInf (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ) x y
273	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y))
274	          ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x ⊓ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y)
275	          (f.le_preimage_inf inf_le_left inf_le_right)
276	          (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y)) :=
277	  rfl
278	
279	@[simp]
280	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_one :
281	    f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (1 : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) = 1 := by
282	  ext x y T a b
283	  exact map_one (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
284	    (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le))
285	
286	@[simp]
287	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_mul (γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
288	    f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (γ₁ * γ₂)
289	      = f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₁ * f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₂ := by
290	  ext x y T a b
291	  exact map_mul (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
292	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le))
293	    (unitsEvInf γ₁ (f.base x) (f.base y)) (unitsEvInf γ₂ (f.base x) (f.base y))
294	
295	/-- Pullback of unit cocycles commutes with restriction along a refinement. -/
296	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_res (h : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
297	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res (fun x ↦ homOfLE (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h x))
298	      = f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (γ.res (fun y ↦ homOfLE (h y))) := by
299	  ext x y T a b
300	  have h₁ := congrArg
301	    (f.unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒲.opens (f.base y)) T
302	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le))
303	    (res_unitsEvInf h γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
304	  rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h₁
305	  exact h₁.symm

307	/-- Pullback of a single coboundary comparison along a morphism of schemes: the honest
308	`Γ`-typed computation behind `pullbackUnitsCocycle_isCohomologous`. -/
309	private lemma pullback_coboundary (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 : Y.PointedCover}
310	    (γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (α : ∀ i : Y, Γ(Y, 𝒰.opens i)ˣ)
311	    (hα : ∀ i j, Y.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ≤ 𝒰.opens i) (α i)
312	          * unitsEvInf γ₁ i j
313	        = unitsEvInf γ₂ i j
314	          * Y.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ≤ 𝒰.opens j) (α j))
315	    (x y : X) {T : X.Opens}
316	    (ha : T ≤ (𝒰.pullback f).opens x) (hb : T ≤ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y) :
317	    X.unitsRestrict ha
318	        (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x) le_rfl
319	          (α (f.base x)))
320	      * f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
321	          (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb) (unitsEvInf γ₁ (f.base x) (f.base y))
322	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
323	          (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb) (unitsEvInf γ₂ (f.base x) (f.base y))
324	        * X.unitsRestrict hb
325	            (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens y) le_rfl
326	              (α (f.base y))) := by
327	  have h' := congrArg
328	    (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb))
329	    (hα (f.base x) (f.base y))
330	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h'
331	  rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
332	  exact h'

334	/-- Pullback of a cohomology relation along a morphism of schemes. -/
335	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_isCohomologous {γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰}
336	    (h : γ₁.IsCohomologous γ₂) :
337	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₁).IsCohomologous (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₂) := by
338	  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := h
339	  exact ⟨fun x ↦ f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x) le_rfl
340	      (α (f.base x)),
341	    fun x y T a b ↦ pullback_coboundary f γ₁ γ₂ α
342	      (fun i j ↦ hα i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)) x y a.le b.le⟩
343	
344	/-- The pullback of unit Čech `H¹` classes along a morphism of schemes. -/
345	def pullbackUnitsH1 (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) :
346	    Y.unitsH1 𝒰 →* X.unitsH1 (𝒰.pullback f) where
347	  toFun := Quot.map f.pullbackUnitsCocycle
348	    (fun _ _ h ↦ f.pullbackUnitsCocycle_isCohomologous h)
349	  map_one' := congrArg OneCocycle.class f.pullbackUnitsCocycle_one
350	  map_mul' a b := by
351	    induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ₁ =>
352	    induction b using Quot.ind with | _ γ₂ =>
353	    exact congrArg (Quot.mk _) (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle_mul γ₁ γ₂)
354

356	lemma pullbackUnitsH1_class (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
357	    f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 γ.class = (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).class :=

361	lemma unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 (h : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (a : Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
362	    unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
363	      = f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒲 (unitsRes h a) := by
364	  induction a using Quot.ind with
365	  | _ γ => exact congrArg (Quot.mk _) (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle_res h γ)

112	structure LocalEquations (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where

OneCohomologyRelation γ₂ γ₁ α⁻¹ := fun i j T a b ↦ by
  rw [← mul_left_inj (G.map b.op (α j)), mul_assoc, ← h i j a b,
    mul_assoc, Cochain₀.inv_apply, map_inv, inv_mul_cancel_left,
    Cochain₀.inv_apply, map_inv, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]

lemma trans {γ₁ γ₂ γ₃ : OneCochain G U} {α β : ZeroCochain G U}
    (h₁₂ : OneCohomologyRelation γ₁ γ₂ α) (h₂₃ : OneCohomologyRelation γ₂ γ₃ β) :
    OneCohomologyRelation γ₁ γ₃ (β * α) := fun i j T a b ↦ by
  dsimp
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc, h₁₂ i j a b, ← mul_assoc,
    h₂₃ i j a b, mul_assoc]

end OneCohomologyRelation

namespace OneCocycle

/-- The cohomology (equivalence) relation on 1-cocycles. -/
def IsCohomologous (γ₁ γ₂ : OneCocycle G U) : Prop :=
  ∃ (α : ZeroCochain G U), OneCohomologyRelation γ₁.toOneCochain γ₂.toOneCochain α

variable (G U)

lemma equivalence_isCohomologous :
    _root_.Equivalence (IsCohomologous (G := G) (U := U)) where
  refl γ := ⟨_, OneCohomologyRelation.refl γ.toOneCochain⟩
  symm := by
    rintro γ₁ γ₂ ⟨α, h⟩
    exact ⟨_, h.symm⟩
  trans := by
    rintro γ₁ γ₂ γ₂ ⟨α, h⟩ ⟨β, h'⟩
    exact ⟨_, h.trans h'⟩

end OneCocycle

variable (G U) in
/-- The cohomology in degree 1 of a presheaf of groups
`G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat` on a family of objects `U : I → C`. -/
def H1 := Quot (OneCocycle.IsCohomologous (G := G) (U := U))

/-- The cohomology class of a 1-cocycle. -/
def OneCocycle.class (γ : OneCocycle G U) : H1 G U := Quot.mk _ γ

instance : One (H1 G U) where
  one := OneCocycle.class 1

lemma OneCocycle.class_eq_iff (γ₁ γ₂ : OneCocycle G U) :
    γ₁.class = γ₂.class ↔ γ₁.IsCohomologous γ₂ :=
  (equivalence_isCohomologous _ _).quot_mk_eq_iff _ _

lemma OneCocycle.IsCohomologous.class_eq {γ₁ γ₂ : OneCocycle G U} (h : γ₁.IsCohomologous γ₂) :
    γ₁.class = γ₂.class :=
  Quot.sound h

end PresheafOfGroups

end CategoryTheory

9	/-!
10	# Extraction: equal classes differ by a principal divisor
11	
12	For the curve bundle `X` (integral, smooth of relative dimension one and quasi-compact
13	over a field `K`), this file proves the extraction half of the meromorphic bridge
14	(deg-D2 W4): if two meromorphic presentations present the same Čech Picard class, their
15	divisors differ by the principal divisor of a single rational function.
16	
17	## Route
18	
19	Equal classes are, on a common refinement `𝒲`, cohomologous cocycles: there is a
20	`0`-cochain of unit sections `α` conjugating one into the other. The elements
21	`c x := P.elem x · (Q.elem x)⁻¹ · germ_η (α x) ∈ K(X)ˣ` then agree for all `x` — the
22	coboundary identity pushed to `η` is literal equality of field elements (decision D1: no
23	sheaf gluing) — so they are *one* rational function `g`, and `div g = D_P − D_Q` because
24	`germ_η (α x)` has trivial order at `x` (`Scheme.ordZ_germGenericUnits`).
25	
26	Together with the class law this gives the full characterization
27	`MeromorphicPresentation.picClass_eq_iff_exists_divOf`: two presentations present the
28	same class iff their divisors differ by a principal divisor.
29	-/
30	
31	set_option autoImplicit false
32	
33	universe u
34	
35	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
36	
37	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
38	
39	namespace Scheme

41	namespace MeromorphicPresentation

43	/-- Constancy extraction in a commutative group: if `A · (pₓ / p_y) = (qₓ / q_y) · B`
44	(the coboundary identity at `η`), then `pₓ / qₓ · A = p_y / q_y · B` (the two candidate
45	rational functions agree). -/
46	private lemma comm_group_const {G : Type u} [CommGroup G] {A B px py qx qy : G}
47	    (h : A * (px * py⁻¹) = qx * qy⁻¹ * B) :
48	    px * qx⁻¹ * A = py * qy⁻¹ * B := by
49	  have h' := congrArg (· * (py * qx⁻¹)) h
50	  simp only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left] at h' ⊢
51	  exact h'

53	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
54	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
55	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
56	
57	/-- **Extraction** (the W4 keystone): if two meromorphic presentations present the same
58	Čech Picard class, their divisors differ by the principal divisor of a single rational
59	function. The cobounding unit sections are glued inside `K(X)ˣ`: the elements
60	`P.elem x · (Q.elem x)⁻¹ · germ_η (α x)` agree as field elements, and their common value
61	is the required function. -/
62	theorem exists_divOf_of_picClass_eq {P Q : X.MeromorphicPresentation}
63	    (h : P.picClass = Q.picClass) :
64	    ∃ g : X.functionFieldˣ,
65	      presentationDivisor K P - presentationDivisor K Q
66	        = Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g := by
67	  have hmk : CechPic.mk P.cover P.cocycle.class = CechPic.mk Q.cover Q.cocycle.class := h
68	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩ := CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp hmk
69	  have hcoh : (P.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₁ k)).IsCohomologous
70	      (Q.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₂ k)) :=
71	    (OneCocycle.class_eq_iff (P.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₁ k))
72	      (Q.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₂ k))).mp e
73	  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp hcoh
74	  -- the coboundary identity, in `Γ`-typed form
75	  have hα' : ∀ x y : X,
76	      X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ 𝒲.opens x) (α x)
77	          * unitsEvInf (P.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₁ k)) x y
78	        = unitsEvInf (Q.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₂ k)) x y
79	          * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ 𝒲.opens y) (α y) :=
80	    fun x y => hα x y
81	  -- the candidate rational functions agree as field elements (D1: gluing is equality)
82	  have hconst : ∀ x y : X,
83	      P.elem x * (Q.elem x)⁻¹
84	          * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens x) (α x)
85	        = P.elem y * (Q.elem y)⁻¹
86	          * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens y) (α y) := by
87	    intro x y
88	    have key := congrArg (germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_inf x y)) (hα' x y)
89	    rw [map_mul, map_mul, germGenericUnits_unitsRestrict, germGenericUnits_unitsRestrict,
90	      P.germGenericUnits_unitsEvInf_res h₁ x y, Q.germGenericUnits_unitsEvInf_res h₂ x y]
91	      at key
92	    exact comm_group_const key
93	  -- the common value, read off at the generic-point index
94	  refine ⟨P.elem (genericPoint X) * (Q.elem (genericPoint X))⁻¹
95	      * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens (genericPoint X))
96	        (α (genericPoint X)), ?_⟩
97	  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt fun z hz => ?_
98	  have hval : Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
99	      (P.elem z * (Q.elem z)⁻¹
100	        * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens z) (α z))
101	      = Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz (P.elem z)
102	        * (Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz (Q.elem z))⁻¹ := by
103	    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv,
104	      ordZ_germGenericUnits K (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens z) (α z) hz (𝒲.mem_opens z),
105	      mul_one]
106	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, coeffAt_presentationDivisor, coeffAt_presentationDivisor,
107	    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_divOf, hconst (genericPoint X) z, hval, toAdd_mul, toAdd_inv,
108	    sub_eq_add_neg]
109	
110	/-- **The meromorphic characterization of the Čech Picard group**: two presentations
111	present the same class iff their divisors differ by a principal divisor. -/
112	theorem picClass_eq_iff_exists_divOf {P Q : X.MeromorphicPresentation} :
113	    P.picClass = Q.picClass
114	      ↔ ∃ g : X.functionFieldˣ,
115	          presentationDivisor K P - presentationDivisor K Q
116	            = Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g := by
117	  refine ⟨exists_divOf_of_picClass_eq K, ?_⟩
118	  rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
119	  have hdiv : presentationDivisor K (Q * principal g) = presentationDivisor K P := by
120	    rw [presentationDivisor_mul, presentationDivisor_principal, ← hg]
121	    abel
122	  have hcl := picClass_eq_of_presentationDivisor_eq K hdiv
123	  rw [picClass_mul, picClass_principal, mul_one] at hcl
124	  exact hcl.symm
125	
126	end MeromorphicPresentation
127	
128	end Scheme

130	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- The universal property of open immersions:
For an open immersion `f : X ⟶ Z`, given any morphism of schemes `g : Y ⟶ Z` whose topological
image is contained in the image of `f`, we can lift this morphism to a unique `Y ⟶ X` that
commutes with these maps.
-/
def lift (H' : Set.range g ⊆ Set.range f) : Y ⟶ X :=
  ⟨LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift f.toLRSHom g.toLRSHom H'⟩

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem lift_fac (H' : Set.range g ⊆ Set.range f) : lift f g H' ≫ f = g :=
  Scheme.Hom.ext' <| LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac f.toLRSHom g.toLRSHom H'

theorem lift_uniq (H' : Set.range g ⊆ Set.range f) (l : Y ⟶ X) (hl : l ≫ f = g) :
    l = lift f g H' :=
  Scheme.Hom.ext' <| LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_uniq
    f.toLRSHom g.toLRSHom H' l.toLRSHom congr(($hl).toLRSHom)
